articleTitle: Medical imaging applications of telecom sources
abstract: Telecom sources have become crucial elements of biophotonic imaging systems including optical coherence tomography and diffuse optical tomography. This presentation will focus on emerging applications of ultrabroadband and swept laser sources in optical coherence tomography.

articleTitle: Fatigue characteristics of Si movable comb inserted into MEMS optical devices
abstract: Fatigue life for the moving part had been inspected at the real operation condition for the first time. The obtained fracture rate was about 0.3 indicated the MEMS devices were reliable enough for practical usage.

articleTitle: Single longitudinal mode multiwavelength fiber ring lasers
abstract: A single longitudinal mode multiwavelength fiber ring laser is demonstrated. The single longitudinal mode multiwavelength operation is obtained using a fiber loop mirror with a saturable absorber and a Lyot-Sagnac filter or a fiber grating array.

articleTitle: Fabrication and analysis of add-drop filters based on microring resonators in SiN
abstract: Add-drop filters based on microring resonators were fabricated in silicon-rich silicon nitride. Third-order microring filters showed an 80 GHz bandwidth, a 4 dB loss from input to drop, and a 24 nm free spectral-range.

articleTitle: Electronic signal processing for differential phase modulation formats
abstract: We present simulations of novel electronic signal processing techniques that may be used to greatly improve the dispersion tolerance of DBPSK and DQPSK modulation formats by at least a factor of two.

articleTitle: Bismuth-based optical fiber with nonlinear coefficient of 1360 W/sup -1/ km/sup -1/
abstract: We developed a conventional step-index type highly nonlinear bismuth oxide-based glass fiber. This fiber exhibits high nonlinearity (/spl gamma/=1360 W/sup -1/ km/sup -1/) because of the high nonlinearity of the glass material and the small effective core area.

articleTitle: Low loss (1.7 dB/km) hollow core photonic bandgap fiber
abstract: We report a silica hollow core photonic bandgap fiber with a minimum attenuation of 1.72 dB/km at 1565 nm wavelength and discuss the scaling of attenuation with wavelength and the minimum loss wavelength in this type of fiber.

articleTitle: Electrical PMD equalizer ICs for a 40-Gbit/s transmission
abstract: Electrical PMD equalizer ICs for 40-Gbit/s transmission were developed using InP/InGaAs HBT technology. In experiments using a PMD emulator, these ICs exhibit good compensation for DGD of over 20 psec at 40 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Optical-CDMA incorporating phase coding of coherent frequency bins: concept, simulation, experiment
abstract: Summary form only given. We present an initial feasibility demonstration of a WDM-compatible optical-CDMA system using 16 phase-locked laser lines within an 80 GHz tunable window as frequency chips and an ultrahigh frequency resolution phase shifting encoder/decoder.

articleTitle: Viterbi equalizer for mitigation of distortions from chromatic dispersion and PMD at 10 Gb/s
abstract: Electrical distortion mitigation simulations at 10 Gb/s using 2 and 4 state Viterbi equalizers exhibit a 3 dB penalty limit for a DGD of 80 ps and for a chromatic dispersion of 3100 ps/nm, which outperforms analog equalizers.

articleTitle: State-of-the-art performance of widely tunable modulated grating Y-branch lasers
abstract: Novel monolithic tunable laser diode with wide tuning range (191.05-196.80 THz), high side-mode suppression ratio (> 40 dB), high output power (> 13 dBm) and low power variation (< 1.5 dB) without additional amplification.

articleTitle: Ultra wide band 190 Gbit/s WDM transmission over a long length and low loss PCF
abstract: Ultra wide band transmission performance of an endlessly-single mode photonic crystal fiber (PCF) has been demonstrated experimentally using a wavelength range from 850 to 1550 nm, which corresponds to 160 THz, for the first time. 10 Gbit/s based WDM signals with a total capacity of 190 Gbit/s have been successfully transmitted over a low loss PCF.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s Mach-Zehnder modulator integrated with widely-tunable sampled grating DBR laser
abstract: We report on a sampled grating DBR laser monolithically integrated with a Mach-Zehnder modulator and a semiconductor optical amplifier. Transmission over 100 km of standard fiber at 10 Gb/s is demonstrated across 30 nm tuning range.

articleTitle: Low-loss and compact TFF-embedded silica-waveguide WDM filter for video distribution services in FTTH systems
abstract: Silica-waveguide 1.50/1.55 /spl mu/m WDM filters with a TFF-embedded configuration have been developed for video distribution services in FTTH systems. These filters exhibit low insertion losses of less than 1 dB and high reliability.

articleTitle: An ultrawide-band (120 nm) semiconductor optical amplifier having an extremely-high penalty-free output power of 23 dBm realized with quantum-dot active layers
abstract: A semiconductor optical amplifier having a gain of >20 dB, noise figure of >7 dB, and 3-dB saturation output power of >19 dBm, over the record widest bandwidth of 120 nm among all kinds of optical amplifiers, and also having a penalty-free output power of 23 dBm, the record highest among all the semiconductor optical amplifiers, was realized by using quantum dots.

articleTitle: A high power, broadband tunable laser module based on a DS-DBR laser with integrated SOA
abstract: A high power, broadband tunable laser module operating over the C-band is presented which is based upon a monolithically integrated DS-DBR tunable laser and semiconductor optical amplifier. These modules have been calibrated to achieve 80 channels at 50 GHz spacing with minimum channel powers of 13.5 dBm and SMSR greater than 40 dB. RIN and linewidth measurements confirm that feedback from the SOA has minimal effect on the tuning performance of the DS-DBR.

articleTitle: Field trial of 160 Gbit/s OTDM add/drop node in a link 275 km deployed fiber
abstract: We demonstrate a 160 Gbit/s OTDM add/drop network comprising an OTDM add/drop node placed in a link of 275 km field deployed fiber. Excellent operation of clock recovery, drop/through/add functions, and transmission is reported.

articleTitle: Wavelength tunable 10 GHz, 3 ps pulse source using a dispersion decreasing fiber based nonlinear optical loop mirror
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the use of a dispersion decreasing fiber (DDF) based nonlinear optical loop mirror for the generation of 10 GHz, wavelength tunable soliton-like pulses. 12 ps Gaussian pulses from an electro-absorption modulator (EAM) followed by 125 m of DCF are compressed into 3 ps pedestal-free pulses using both high-order soliton compression and nonlinear switching effects within an 8.5 km DDF based loop mirror. Wavelength tuning of the compressed pulses over a /spl sim/15 nm bandwidth is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: All-optical label switching/swapping of 160 Gbps variable length packets and 10 Gbps labels using a WDM Raman enhanced-XPM fiber wavelength converter with unicast/multicast operation
abstract: We report the first demonstration of all-optical label switching of variable-length 160 Gbps packets and swapping of 10 Gbps optical labels with real time switching and unicast/multicast operation using a WDM Raman enhanced all-optical fiber cross-phase modulation wavelength converter. Packet BER is measured for all channels and error free operation is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhanced analytical engineering rule for fast optimization dispersion maps in 40 Gbit/s-based transmission
abstract: We exhibit a simple method to evaluate non-linear propagation impairments in the context of 40 Gbit/s-based dispersion-managed systems and deduce a very useful design rule to quickly optimize the tuning of pre- or in-line dispersion compensations.

articleTitle: A duplex WDM passive optical network with 1:16 power split using reflective SOA remodulator at ONU
abstract: A duplex WDM passive optical network with a wavelength independent transceiver was demonstrated by remodulating downstream signal with a reflective semiconductor optical amplifier. Successful operation at 2.5 Gbps downstream and 900 Mbps upstream was achieved.

articleTitle: Compact full C-band tunable filters for 50 GHz channel spacing based on high order micro-ring resonators
abstract: Full C-band tunable filters for 50 GHz channel spacings based on 5/sup th/ order micro-ring resonator filters are described. These filters are tunable over 40 nm and can accommodate one hundred 50 GHz channels.

articleTitle: High capacity multiservice in-house networks using mode group diversity multiplexing
abstract: Mode group diversity multiplexing integrates multiple services in a single in-home multimode fibre network, by deploying mode groups in parallel. Compensating mode-mixing with cheap electrical signal processors, its functionality equals wavelength multiplexing at lower costs.

articleTitle: Delay-interferometer-based optical pulse generator
abstract: We demonstrate a chirp-free optical pulse generator using a phase modulator and a delay interferometer. Both 33% duty cycle RZ and 67% duty cycle CSRZ pulses are generated with a repetition rate of 40 GHz.

articleTitle: A PMD-insensitive OSNR monitoring scheme based on polarization-nulling with off-center narrowband filtering
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate using polarization-nulling with off-center narrowband filtering to monitor OSNR for 10-Gb/s and 40-Gb/s RZ signals. Robustness to PMD is significantly enhanced compared with prior polarization-nulling scheme without employing narrowband filtering.

articleTitle: Optical burst switching: research and applications
abstract: We describe recent developments in dynamic, wavelength-routed OBS networks. The challenges and limitations of this architecture in edge router design, lightpath request scheduling, quality of service provisioning and the impact of traffic statistics are identified.

articleTitle: Raman crosstalk in video overlay passive optical networks
abstract: This work studies the Raman coupling effect in ITU-T G.983.3-based PON systems carrying subcarrier modulated analog video. We find the Raman effect is present but is controllable to negligible levels, provided that system parameters are optimised.

articleTitle: 1.6 bit/s/Hz orthogonally polarized CSRZ-DQPSK transmission of 8/spl times/40 Gbit/s over 320 km NDSF
abstract: We report experimental results of 1.6 bit/s/Hz, 8/spl times/40 Gbit/s OP-CSRZ-DQPSK transmission over 320 km NDSF and demonstration of an 8-fold extension in 40 Gbit/s chromatic dispersion tolerance and a doubling of 40 Gbit/s PMD tolerance without any adjustable compensator.

articleTitle: "Long-term" PMD characterization of installed fibers-how much time is adequate?
abstract: We performed long-term differential group delay (DGD) measurements on multiple installed fiber spans. Unexpectedly, the statistical distributions of these measurements deviate strongly from existing theory. We offer evidence that analysis of measurement statistics themselves can indicate their validity.

articleTitle: Full C-band slope-matched dispersion compensation based on a phase sampled Bragg grating
abstract: A 51 channel fiber Bragg grating slope-matched dispersion compensator is produced with a complex phase mask. The phase mask includes a phase sampling function with a linearly chirped sampling period to achieve dispersion slope-matching.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of simple NOLM-based 2R regenerator for 42.66 Gbit/s WDM long-haul transmissions
abstract: A NOLM incorporating highly nonlinear fiber is implemented in a 42.66 Gbit/s dispersion-managed RZ loop, yielding Q-factors of 12.7 dB and 11 dB at 10,000 km distance in single-channel and in WDM environment with five 200 GHz-spaced 42.66 Gbit/s channels, respectively.

articleTitle: Efficiency of different feedback signals for polarization mode dispersion compensators
abstract: The efficiency of different feedback signals for PMD compensators in systems with different modulation formats is studied and compared. We show that the efficiency of some feedback signals has a strong dependence on modulation formats.

articleTitle: C+L band MEMS tunable external cavity semiconductor laser
abstract: Full C and L band tuning of a compact, MEMS-tuned external cavity semiconductor laser is obtained using a MEMS-actuated lens to switch between resonator configurations, including one configuration that tunes continuously over 5 THz.

articleTitle: Bend-insensitive and low-splice-loss optical fiber for indoor wiring in FTTH
abstract: A bend-insensitive fiber with a trench index profile is presented. A bending loss of 0.1dB/turn at 1650 nm for a bending diameter of 20 mm and MFD of 8.1 /spl mu/m at 1310 nm was realized simultaneously.

articleTitle: Low-operation-current and highly-reliable 1.3-/spl mu/m AlGaInAs strain compensated MQW-BH-DFB lasers for 100/spl deg/C, 10-Gb/s operation
abstract: A record-low 25.8-mA/sub p-p/ modulation current for 10-Gb/s modulation at 100/spl deg/C was demonstrated using AlGaInAs strain compensated MQW-BH-DFB lasers. A median life of more than 1/spl times/10/sup 5/ hours at 85/spl deg/C was estimated after an aging test of 4000 hours.

articleTitle: The impact of nonlinearity on electronic dispersion compensation of optical channels
abstract: We show that the nonlinear, non-minimum phase nature of the optical channel is largely responsible for the marked performance difference between maximum likelihood sequence estimation (MLSE) and decision-feedback equalizer (DFE) approaches to dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Fiber based compensation of IXPM induced timing jitter
abstract: We derive from an analytical approach conditions to cancel out timing jitter by balancing intra channel effects in subsequent link sections. In numerical simulations we proof the applicability of a fiber based compensating structure at 40 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Destruction of silica fiber cladding by fiber fuse effect
abstract: The phenomenon of silica fiber cladding destruction by the fiber fuse effect has been observed for the first time. The cladding destruction leads to the termination of the optical discharge propagation in a fiber.

articleTitle: Nonlinear effects in phase shift keyed transmission
abstract: Phase-shift-keyed modulation formats have recently shown superior performance in some nonlinear transmissions. This paper will review the understanding of their tolerance to various fiber nonlinearities in different transmission regimes in terms of data rate and spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Shared mesh restoration in optical networks
abstract: Four key economic and operational benefits from mesh optical networking are discussed. They are (1) end-to-end routing and provisioning, (2) fast and capacity-efficient restoration, (3) re-provisioning, and (4) re-optimization. They contribute in various ways to network cost savings and higher network and service reliability in mesh networks compared to traditional ring-based networks.

articleTitle: Evaluating the impact of the link-state update period on the blocking performance of wavelength-routed networks
abstract: The impact of the link-state update period on the blocking performance of wavelength-routed networks is evaluated. We show that exclusive use of wavelengths and wavelength continuity constraint cause the impact to be highly load-sensitive.

articleTitle: Low-PDL 16-channel variable optical attenuator array using silica-based PLC
abstract: We successfully reduced the PDL of a silica-based PLC-VOA array at an attenuation of 15 dB to 0.3 dB by forming stress-releasing grooves and by employing a cross-path in an asymmetric Mach-Zehnder interferometer.

articleTitle: A novel wavelength modulated transmitter and its application in WDM passive optical networks
abstract: We propose a novel wavelength modulated transmitter based on an optical phase modulator and demonstrate its application in a WDM-PON to facilitate upstream data re-modulation. The feasibility and performance of the system are experimentally investigated.

articleTitle: Measurements of gain and phase dynamics of a semiconductor optical amplifier using spectrograms
abstract: The temporal dynamics of the gain and phase of a pump-modulated SOA are measured using the spectrogram technique. The phase response is temporally delayed owing to the ultrafast nonlinear processes. We also measure the pattern dependence at 40 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Adaptive PMD compensator in 160 Gb/s DPSK transmission over installed fiber
abstract: We report on a magneto- and electro-optically tuned dynamic PMD compensator that enabled error-free single-channel 160 Gb/s RZ-DPSK transmission over a 75 km SMF link (PMD>0.3T/sub Bit/). Polarization scrambling and DOP measurements were utilized to automatically adapt the compensator.

articleTitle: Traffic grooming in mesh optical networks
abstract: Traffic grooming deals with efficiently packing/unpacking low-speed connections onto high-capacity trunks. We examine traffic grooming for optical mesh networks by reviewing grooming-node architectures, traffic models, grooming policies, novel graph models, survivable grooming, and hierarchical switching, etc.

articleTitle: Electronic equalisation for low cost 10 Gbit/s directly modulated systems
abstract: We present measurements and simulations of the improvement due to electronic signal processing on 10 Gbit/s directly modulated lasers. MLSE algorithms with strong FEC can enable reaches in excess of 300 km NDSF without optical dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Bit-rate-transparent nonreturn-to-zero all-optical wavelength conversion at up to 42 Gb/s by operating symmetric-Mach-Zehnder switch with new scheme
abstract: We propose a new operating scheme of the Symmetric-Mach-Zehnder all-optical switch for bit-rate-transparent NRZ wavelength conversion. We experimentally demonstrate error-free operation in the range from 2.5 to 42 Gb/s without changing other operating conditions.

articleTitle: Four user, 2.5 Gb/s, spectrally coded O-CDMA system demonstration using low power nonlinear processing
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time 2.5 Gb/s four user O-CDMA operation at /spl les/10/sup -11/ BER utilizing programmable spectral phase encoding, an ultrasensitive (<0.4 pJ/bit) PPLN-waveguide nonlinear waveform discriminator and 10 G Ethernet receiver.

articleTitle: Compensation of intra-channel nonlinearities in 40 Gb/s pseudo-linear systems using optical phase conjugation
abstract: We compensate intra-channel nonlinearities in an RZ-DPSK-40 Gb/s 32/spl times/100 km system using a LiNbO/sub 3/ conjugator and achieve 2 decades of improvement in BER. Transmission limited to 5200 km at a BER=5/spl times/10/sup -4/ is extended to 6400 km with phase conjugation.

articleTitle: Self-referencing dispersion characterization of multimode structures using direct instantaneous frequency measurement
abstract: We present a technique for the self-referencing simultaneous characterization of the chromatic dispersion of the modes of a multimode structure. The group delays of the two modes of a high-order mode dispersion-compensating module are measured.

articleTitle: Demonstration of synchronous traffic transport over a time-multiplexed WDM ring
abstract: We demonstrate a periodically-scheduled, time-multiplexed WDM ring that combines the bandwidth granularity and scalability of time-slotted WDM rings with the QoS characteristics of SONET. The ring transports SONET traffic over wavelength-switched asynchronous 10 Gb/s packets.

articleTitle: 10-Gbit/s, 100-km SMF transmission using an InP-based n-i-n Mach-Zehnder modulator with a driving voltage of 1.0 V/sub pp/
abstract: We report a 1.0 V/sub pp/ push-pull driven Mach-Zehnder modulator with an n-i-n heterostructure fabricated on an InP substrate. We achieved a 100 km transmission through single-mode fiber (SMF) at 10 Gbit/s with a power penalty of less than 1.5 dB.

articleTitle: Nonlinear tolerance of differential phase shift keying modulated signals reduced by XPM
abstract: We show that in order to maintain the high nonlinear tolerance of the DQPSK modulation format, XPM from neighboring OOK-modulated channels must be avoided. The negative impact on 10 Gb/s DQPSK channels is higher than at 20 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated SOA-MZI wavelength converter with assist DFB-LD
abstract: Monolithically integrated wavelength converter based on semiconductor optical amplifier with distributed feedback laser diode is fabricated. Gain recovery time of 7 ps is achieved for the semiconductor optical amplifier in experiment with simulated optimization.

articleTitle: 42/spl times/42.7 Gb/s RZ-DPSK transmission over a 4820 km long NZDSF deployed line using C-band-only EDFAs
abstract: The transmission of 42 RZ-DPSK channels at 42.7 Gb/s is demonstrated over 4820 km of NZDSF deployed line with more than 3 dB margin. A performance comparison with the same capacity using 166/spl times/10 Gb/s DPSK is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Electronic equalization and FEC enable bidirectional CWDM capacities of 9.6 Tb/s-km
abstract: Using electronic equalization to combat chromatic dispersion and forward error correction (FEC) to increase robustness to in-band crosstalk, we demonstrate CWDM capacities of 32/spl times/10 Gb/s (2/spl times/16, full-duplex) over >30 km of low-water-peak standard single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Field measurements of state of polarization and PMD from a tier-1 carrier
abstract: Field measurements of the state of polarization in buried and aerial transmission fiber are presented and analyzed. State of polarization changes measured under field conditions are compared to the state of polarization changes generated by commercially available polarization scramblers for the purpose of laboratory evaluation.

articleTitle: New nonlinear fibers with application to amplifiers
abstract: Highly nonlinear fibers (HNLFs) have been explored as candidates for the media of Raman amplification and optical parametric amplification with broad gain bandwidths. This paper reviews state-of-the-art HNLFs and the application to discrete Raman amplification.

articleTitle: Multichannel PMD mitigation through forward-error-correction with distributed fast PMD scrambling
abstract: We propose a multichannel PMD mitigation scheme using forward-error-correction (FEC) and distributed fast polarization scramblers that randomize PMD during each FEC burst-error-correcting-period. Numerical evaluations show substantial improvement in PMD tolerance and reduction in outage probability.

articleTitle: RZ-DPSK field trial over 13,100 km of installed non slope-matched submarine fibers
abstract: We successfully conducted a 96/spl times/10 Gb/s RZ-DPSK field trial over an installed 13,100 km optical undersea path with more than 3 dB FEC margin, including channels with >13,000 ps/nm dispersion. The performance was further improved 1-2 dB by adding prechirp.

articleTitle: High-speed waveguide switches for optical routers and networks
abstract: This paper presents an optical waveguide switch with a switching time of 1.26-1.39 ns in the C band and demonstrates optical packet switching for an optical packet stream with a 40-Gbps NRZ signal.

articleTitle: 1.14 b/s/Hz spectrally-efficient 50/spl times/85.4 Gb/s transmission over 300 km using copolarized CS-RZ DQPSK signals
abstract: 1.14 b/s/Hz spectrally-efficient 50/spl times/85.4 Gb/s transmission over 300 km (75 km/spl times/4 spans) of NZ-DSF has been successfully demonstrated with copolarized CS-RZ DQPSK signals. 42.7 Gsymbol/s-based 4 Tb/s DQPSK transmission has been achieved for the first time without polarization multiplexing.

articleTitle: Simultaneous and arbitrary wavelength conversion of WDM signals using multiple wavelength quasi phase matched LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguide
abstract: We propose simultaneous and arbitrary wavelength conversion of WDM signals using a multiple wavelength quasi phase matched LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguide and successfully demonstrate for the first time wideband conversion of 4-channel signals over more than 35 nm.

articleTitle: Digital signal processing and electronic equalization (EE) of ISI
abstract: This work will discuss the evolution of electronic techniques, the applicability and effectiveness of digital signal processing (DSP) as a cost effective solution to ISI problem with a focus on high speed (10 GBPS) optical channels.

articleTitle: Rare-earth-doped fiber amplifier for eight-channel CWDM transmission systems
abstract: We describe a rare-earth-doped optical fiber amplifier for a CWDM transmission system that uses eight channels ranging from 1470 to 1610 nm. The amplifier has a relatively simple configuration and achieved an average gain of 22.5 dB with a gain variation of 2 dB in the 1463-1537 and 1543-1617 nm wavelength regions.

articleTitle: Experimental verification of combined adaptive PMD and GVD compensation in a 40 Gb/s transmission using integrated optical FIR-filters and spectrum monitoring
abstract: We prove the capability of adaptive PMD compensation with integrated optical FIR-filters in lattice structure and an electrical spectrum monitoring based feedback signal in 40 Gb/s experiments. Moreover we present the combined PMD and GVD compensation.

articleTitle: Combining control electronics with SOA to equalize packet- to-packet power variations for optical 3R regeneration in optical networks at 10 Gbit/s
abstract: We report on the combined effects of control electronics and a SOA as to suppress packet to packet power fluctuations. Associated to a SOA-MZI based 3R regenerator, we demonstrate a power dynamic range of 9 dB.

articleTitle: DC-balanced line encoding for optical labeling scheme using orthogonal modulation
abstract: It is shown both theoretically and experimentally that 8B/10B encoding is an efficient technique to mitigate the inherent modulation crosstalk in optical labeling scheme using orthogonal modulation.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of constellation diagrams of optical sources
abstract: We present the first temporal diagnostic that measures statistical information on both the intensity and phase of data-encoded channels. Experimental characterization of differential-phase shift keyed signals at 10 Gb/s and 40 Gb/s is presented.

articleTitle: A new optical switching fabric architecture incorporating rapidly switching all-optical variable delay buffers
abstract: This paper discusses new optical packet switch architectures utilizing all-optical variable delay buffers functioning as input and output queues in addition to circulating fixed buffers, and shows the simulation performance of the proposed architectures.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of single-mode operation of large-core segmented cladding fiber
abstract: Segmented cladding fibers were fabricated with PMMA polymer. Single-mode operation at 1.55 /spl mu/m was observed with a 36.5-cm long fiber that consisted of 4 cladding segments and had a core diameter of 20 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Economic analysis of IP/optical network architectures
abstract: This paper analyzes four architectures for carrying a typical, large ISP backbone over an optical network. Our results suggest that providing restoration via an opaque reconfigurable optical network does not provide significant cost savings.

articleTitle: All-optical 40Gb/s cross-wavelength transferred clock recovery for 3R wavelength conversion using a traveling wave electroabsorption modulator-based resonant cavity
abstract: An all-optical, compact clock recovery is demonstrated by utilizing filtered and actively amplified photocurrent in a traveling-wave electroabsorption modulator. 40 GHz optical clock was recovered from 40 Gb/s OTDM and transferred to new clock wavelength.

articleTitle: Integrated optical receiver for RZ-DQPSK transmission systems
abstract: The paper discusses design, realization and characterization of an integrated-optical receiver for RZ-DQPSK signals. The receiver consists of a pair of Mach-Zehnder delayed interferometers realized in high index contrast SION technology.

articleTitle: Investigation of a spectrally flat multi-wavelength DWDM source based on optical phase- and intensity-modulation
abstract: We investigate a simple DWDM source based on phase- and intensity-modulation. A 31-channel frequency comb with /spl plusmn/1.5 dB power variation, penalty-free operation and operation over 100 nm is demonstrated. The coherent crosstalk concern in real systems is also addressed.

articleTitle: Extremely fast (microsecond timescale) polarization changes in high speed long haul WDM transmission systems
abstract: Causes for microsecond timescale polarization changes in high speed WDM transmission systems were analyzed experimentally. Coiled patch cables and spooled DCF in combination with mechanical vibrations were identified as sources of Stokes vector movements with velocities of >45,000 rotations/sec.

articleTitle: Calculation of error probability in WDM RZ systems in presence of bit-pattern-dependent nonlinearity and of noise
abstract: We introduce a fully deterministic, computationally efficient method for calculating the error probability in wavelength-division multiplexed return-to-zero systems that accurately accounts for bit-pattern-dependent nonlinear distortions and noise.

articleTitle: PMD compensation: a system perspective
abstract: The application of PMD compensation in transmission systems is considered from a cost perspective. We find that PMD compensation is useful only for a limited range of systems and fiber PMD coefficients.

articleTitle: Apodization of 25 and 50 GHz low dispersion FBG WDM filters by phase modulation coding of a phase mask
abstract: Low dispersion FBG WDM filters are written in a simple and efficient way using a complex phase mask. High frequency phase modulation and /spl pi//2 phase shifts encoded into the mask provide the required apodization profile.

articleTitle: Highly nonlinear bismuth-oxide-based glass holey fiber
abstract: We report on the fabrication of the first bismuth-oxide-based glass holey fiber. We measured high nonlinearity of /spl gamma/=460 W/sup -1/ km/sup -1/ at 1550 nm. Simulations predict anomalous dispersion at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: WDM transmission at 6 Tbit/s capacity over transatlantic distance, using 42.7Gb/s differential phase-shift keying without pulse carver
abstract: We report the transmission of a record 6 Tbit/s capacity over 6,120 km distance, involving channels modulated at 42.7 Gb/s bit-rate with differential phase-shift keying (DPSK). The performance is found similar to DPSK with subsequent pulse carving, namely RZ-DPSK.

articleTitle: Demonstration of optical packet switching scheme for header-payload separation and class-based forwarding
abstract: We propose and experimentally verify a design realizing a novel scheme for key optical packet switching functionalities: header-payload separation, class of service segregation and packet forwarding.

articleTitle: Add-on filtering technology for L/U-band extended optical fiber line testing system using wideband and high cutoff chirped FBG
abstract: This paper describes add-on filtering technology for an L/U-band extended optical fiber line testing system. We have developed a 15-nm wideband and 45-dB high cutoff chirped FBG filter embedded in a plug-adapter connector.

articleTitle: Optical path, wavelength and power monitoring technique using frequency-modulated pilot tones
abstract: We demonstrate a simple technique to monitor the optical paths, wavelengths, and powers of WDM signals using frequency-modulated (FM) pilot tones. Unlike the previously proposed monitoring technique using amplitude-modulated (AM) pilot tones, the proposed technique does not suffer from the cross-gain modulation and stimulated Raman scattering.

articleTitle: Polarization sensitivity of 40 Gb/s transmission over short-reach 62.5 /spl mu/m multimode fiber using single-mode transceivers
abstract: System performance of 40 Gb/s transmission over short-reach, commercial-grade 62.5 /spl mu/m multimode fiber using readily available single-mode transceivers is highly sensitive to launch polarization. Return-to-zero transmission experienced 3-dB power penalty, while nonreturn-to-zero suffered link outage.

articleTitle: Transmission of 20/spl times/20 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK signals over 5090 km with 0.53 b/s/Hz spectral efficiency
abstract: We demonstrate a transmission of 20 channels at 20 Gb/s using RZ-DQPSK format over 5090 km of dispersion-managed fiber with distributed Raman amplifiers. For this condition, RZ-DQPSK signals are mainly degraded by single channel distortion.

articleTitle: Electronic dispersion compensation for extended reach
abstract: We investigate the benefits of using post-detection electronic processing in high-speed optical links. In particular, electronic post-processing is studied in conjunction with other advanced methods, such as optical duo-binary encoding and chirped modulation.

articleTitle: Transmission of HDTV and Ethernet data over a WDM-PON employing ASE-injected Fabry-Perot laser diodes
abstract: We used wavelength-locked outputs from ASE-injected F-P LDs having narrow mode spacing and asymmetric facet reflectivity as transmitters in a WDM-PON. Trial transmission of HDTV and Ethernet data over the WDM-PON is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Asymmetric reconfigurable OADMs for next generation metro-DWDM networks
abstract: Reconfigurable OADMs allow responding to unpredictable traffic demand. We propose ROADM structures with asymmetric flexibility at the add vs. drop section and a metric to evaluate their flexibility and their applications in metro-DWDM optical networks.

articleTitle: Novel modulation formats in ultra-high-speed transmission systems, and their applications
abstract: We have proposed novel transmission formats including CS-RZ, DCS-RZ, and CSRZ-DPSK. We discuss the transmission performance of these formats in the aspect of DWDM and present 40 ch/spl times/43-Gbit/s/ch transmission demonstration with excellent amplifier technology.

articleTitle: Adaptive PMD compensation using PSO algorithm
abstract: We demonstrated the experiment of adaptive PMD compensation using Particle Swarm Optimization with local neighborhood structure as control algorithm. The PSO algorithm showed powerful ability of fast searching global optimum without being trapped into suboptima.

articleTitle: Extending the chromatic dispersion tolerance by optical equalization at 43 Gb/s
abstract: Measurements at 43 Gb/s demonstrate a doubling in chromatic dispersion tolerance for non return-to-zero signals using a simple, multichannel optical equalizer structure based on two concatenated Mach-Zehnder interferometers.

articleTitle: 10 Gbit/s optical CDMA encoder-decoder BER performance using HNLF thresholder
abstract: We demonstrate bit-error-rate performance of a 10 Gbit/s optical code division multiple access system based on a spectral-phase encoding scheme. A highly nonlinear fiber based thresholder discriminates between correctly and incorrectly decoded pulses.

articleTitle: PMD and chromatic dispersion control for 10 and 40 Gbps systems
abstract: Techniques for static and dynamic compensation of signal distortions from chromatic dispersion and PMD are outlined. System requirements and transmission design using these compensation techniques are discussed.

articleTitle: Uncooled directly modulated high dynamic range source for IEEE802.11a wireless over fibre LAN applications
abstract: We report the first feed-forward linearized 5.2 GHz uncooled directly modulated 1550 nm DFB laser having 26 dB IMD3 suppression and SFDR enhancement to 107 dB (1 Hz).

articleTitle: 6/spl times/42.7-Gb/s transmission over ten 200-km EDFA-amplified SSMF spans using polarization-alternating RZ-DPSK
abstract: We demonstrate the use of polarization alternation to dramatically improve performance in 42.7-Gb/s WDM transmission. Six channels are transmitted through ten 200-km (39-dB loss) standard-single-mode-fiber spans with amplification provided solely by erbium-doped fiber amplifiers.

articleTitle: High performance variable optical attenuator multiplexer filter (VMUX)
abstract: We report progress on fully integrated variable optical attenuator multiplexers (VMUXs). We show substantial performance improvements, notably very low loss and PDL, and the realization of extremely compact designs in high delta silica-on-silicon.

articleTitle: Analytical interference model for 2-dimensional (time-wavelength) asynchronous OCDMA systems
abstract: We have found a probabilistic model for OCDMA systems that relates the code parameters to the probability of collision-induced-error. For a given code parameters, increased numbers of active users can be accommodated with a reasonable BER.

articleTitle: Method for high-speed Manchester encoded optical signal generation
abstract: A method for high-speed Manchester encoded optical signal generation is proposed and demonstrated with a specially configured electro-optical modulator. A 10 Gb/s Manchester encoded optical signal was generated, and its bit-error-ratio (BER) performance was evaluated.

articleTitle: Optimising scheduling delay in wavelength-routed optical burst switched networks with re-attempt capability
abstract: A novel analytic expression to minimise the delay added in the lightpath scheduler whilst ensuring a maximum blocking probability is derived. This optimises the scheduler and accelerates its design, avoiding unnecessary delays and time-consuming simulations.

articleTitle: Signal transient propagation in an all Raman amplified system
abstract: We measure the propagation of a signal power transient and the associated gain transient in a broadband all Raman amplified system over ultra-long haul distances.

articleTitle: Press-formed aspherical micro lens made of bismuth based glass with high refractive index and transparency
abstract: We have developed press-formed micro lenses made of new bismuth based glass with high refractive index and high transparency at infrared wavelength. They are useful for improving coupling efficiency of optical communication system.

articleTitle: In-fiber Bragg gratings for sensor applications at high temperatures
abstract: Bragg gratings were written in metal-coated nitrogen-doped silica core fibers. The gratings remain functioning at temperatures up to 900/spl deg/C long-term and can be used as sensing elements in various applications.

articleTitle: A novel time-frequency quantum key distribution technique for optical fiber communication systems
abstract: We propose a new quantum encryption scheme that is based on the quantum mechanical duality between time and frequency. We described an experimental implementation using optical fiber and discuss the new protocol's security against eavesdropping.

articleTitle: Compact and low-cost module for power, wavelength, and channel control of DWDM tunable lasers
abstract: Simultaneous monitoring of power, wavelength, and channel for a DWDM tunable laser is demonstrated by using a built-in isolator, etalon, polarizer, and photodiodes. The module is tunable and can detect mode hopping and incomplete tuning.

articleTitle: Modeling noise in optical fiber communications systems
abstract: We describe two different methods for calculating the probability distribution of the voltage at the decision point in the receiver, taking into account transmission nonlinearity. These two methods are in complete agreement.

articleTitle: Blocking probability of a centralized switch with shared wavelength conversion
abstract: This paper presents a new blocking probability model for a centralized switch with shared wavelength conversion. The ingress and egress link wavelengths are selectable. A small number of converters achieves the performance of full conversion.

articleTitle: Negative dispersion-flattened fiber for full-spectrum signal transmission in metropolitan networks
abstract: New dispersion-flattened fibers having negative dispersion of about -8 ps/nm/km over whole telecommunication band are developed. Transmissions with 10 Gb/s directly modulated LDs over 51 km at 1275 nm and over 80 km at 1550 nm are realized without dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Online OTDR monitoring in novel remotely-pumped EDF/distributed Raman hybrid amplifier scheme with directional bypass configuration
abstract: Online OTDR monitoring in a novel online remotely-pumped EDF/distributed Raman hybrid inline amplifier scheme is demonstrated. Using the proposed directional bypass configuration in this scheme realizes online monitoring without transmission impairment.

articleTitle: Suppression of intra-channel nonlinear penalties in high-speed transmissions with alternate polarization formats
abstract: We discuss simple methods to generate alternate polarization (APol) formats, and experimentally study the transmission performance of the APol formats for both 40-Gb/s dispersion-managed (DM) systems and 10-Gb/s DM-soliton systems.

articleTitle: Compact 160-Gb/s add-drop multiplexing with a 40-Gb/s base-rate
abstract: We report on the first 40 Gb/s-based OTDM add-drop multiplexing at 160 Gb/s using electrically driven electroabsorption modulators. Error-free operation for all channels is obtained with an average power penalty of 1 dB.

articleTitle: A novel scheme of lensed fiber employing a quadrangular-pyramid-shaped fiber endface for coupling high-power lasers to single mode fibers
abstract: A novel lensed fiber employing a quadrangular-pyramid-shaped fiber endface (QPSFE) is proposed. This QPSFE can form any different aspect ratios of elliptical microlens to match the far field of high power and commercial diode lasers.

articleTitle: Experimental and numerical investigation of the effect of second order PMD on the differential PSK
abstract: We investigate the effects of second order PMD in differential PSK modulation employing RZ and NRZ signaling formats at 10 Gb/s to prove that NRZ DPSK is more robust than RZ DPSK towards second order PMD.

articleTitle: An overview of the network global expectation model
abstract: I describe and illustrate the application of the network global expectation model, in which expectation values evaluated over the network provide both exact and approximate analytic descriptions of the required quantities and variances of network resources and commensurate costs.

articleTitle: Evaluation on system outage due to statistically distributed chromatic dispersion of optical fiber
abstract: We evaluated the outage probability and scalability of high-speed (>40 Gb/s) optical network caused by the statistically distributed chromatic dispersion of optical fibers. This was to identify when we should use tunable dispersion compensators at every channel.

articleTitle: 200 Mbps VCSEL bi-directional transceiver based on polymer PLC platform
abstract: For an application of FTTH, a novel VCSEL bidirectional transceiver of 200 Mbps data rates up to 2 km communication has been successively developed. It has been constructed using a multimode polymer PLC platform and all passive alignments.

articleTitle: Interferometric PMD measurement of a transatlantic, 5512-km fiber link including 119 EDFAs
abstract: We report end-to-end PMD-measurement of a 5512-km fiber link including 119 EDFAs with an overall gain bandwidth of 20 nm and a high level of output ASE, using a generalized version of the interferometric method.

articleTitle: Distributed optical fiber devices based on liquid crystal infiltrated photonic crystal fibers
abstract: We describe a new class of hybrid photonic crystal fibers, which are liquid crystal infiltrated fibers. Using these fibers, we demonstrate 'distributed' tunable filter and switching functionalities operating by the photonic bandgap effect.

articleTitle: Characterization of highly erbium-doped fibers confocal luminescence microscopy
abstract: Using confocal luminescence microscopy and detailed evaluation of the luminescence spectra in terms of intensity, spectral position and width, we determined the erbium doping profiles and their inhomogeneities in high index profile singly mode fibers.

articleTitle: Polarization dependent loss and its impact in optical communications systems
abstract: We study the effect of polarization dependent loss (PDL) on the signal to noise ratio of optical communications systems. We discuss the value of dynamic gain equalization in this context and show that in most cases of interest, the penalties that are induced by PDL are caused by the coupling of noise that is emitted into a state of polarization that is orthogonal to the signal.

articleTitle: Simultaneous optical demultiplexing and clock recovery using four-wave mixing and timing extraction inside a single electroabsorption modulator
abstract: We report novel technique using single EAM to perform two simultaneous operations: all-optical timing extraction using fast absorption-saturation, and FWM. The extracted timing provides recovered clock, while 80 Gbit/s all-optical demultiplexing was achieved with FWM.

articleTitle: Design of survivable WDM networks with shared-P-cycles
abstract: We propose a new approach, namely shared preconfigured protection cycles (shared-p-cycles), for design of survivable WDM networks. Numerical results show that the shared-p-cycles design is much more efficient than the conventional p-cycles design.

articleTitle: Effects of partial-spectrum filtering on DOP monitoring for PMD compensation
abstract: We investigated the effects of all-order PMD on the DOP monitoring technique based on partial-spectrum filtering for 10-Gb/s NRZ signal. The results showed that the partial-spectrum filtering could not improve the performance of PMD compensation.

articleTitle: Spectral engineering of wavelength-division multiplexers based on planar holographic Bragg reflectors
abstract: We report wavelength-division-multiplexing based on lithographically-fabricated slab-waveguide-contained planar holographic Bragg reflectors. Partial diffractive contour writing and contour displacement are successfully demonstrated to enable precise spectral engineering of multiplexer transfer functions and make possible hologram overlay.

articleTitle: Demonstration of all-fiber narrowband polarimeter based on coherent acousto-optic mode coupling
abstract: A novel all-fiber narrowband polarimeter based on acousto-optic coupling from two orthogonal acoustic waves is proposed and demonstrated. The polarimeter can selectively monitor individual channels in a WDM system with wavelength separation of >1.6 nm.

articleTitle: A novel electrically tuned all-fiber comb filter
abstract: We demonstrated an all-fiber comb filter having an extinction ratio of /spl sim/20 dB using a two-mode fiber. Full free spectral range wavelength tuning is achieved using a thin film micro-heater directly deposited on the fiber.

articleTitle: Progress towards high power 1.5 /spl mu/m GaInNAsSb/GaAs lasers for Raman amplifiers
abstract: We present a CW 1.5 /spl mu/m GaInNAsSb laser with threshold current density of 1.06 kA/cm/sup 2/, characteristic temperature of 101 K, and 140 mW CW output power, tested epitaxial-side up. 527 mW (pulsed) were achieved from a single facet.

articleTitle: Polarization dependent gain analysis of optical parametric amplifier based on measured linear phase mismatch
abstract: A novel evaluation method of polarization dependent linear phase-mismatch is proposed and demonstrated successfully to analyze parallel and perpendicular gains of an optical parametric amplifier. In this report, we introduce Jones matrix measurement of nonlinear fiber to obtain polarization dependent phase-mismatch for analyzing polarization dependent gains of an optical parametric amplifier.

articleTitle: A novel tunable erbium-doped fiber ring laser for measuring polarization mode dispersion of optical fibers
abstract: We describe the design and development of a novel tunable fiber laser and its application to polarization-mode dispersion measurements of optical fibers using broad-band orthogonal-pump four-wave mixing in a semiconductor optical amplifier.

articleTitle: Erbium emission in highly doped tellurite and alumina-silica novelty fibers
abstract: We present a summary of emission properties of doped tellurite and alumina-silica fibers. The tellurite fiber offer higher and flatter signal gain over shorter lengths and the alumina-silica fiber, lower losses and better physical properties.

articleTitle: Optical packet networks - conclusions from the IST DAVID project
abstract: This work outlines the result from the European research project DAVID working with optical packet switch solutions for both WAN and MAN. The project started July 2000 and has been completed successfully by the end of 2003.

articleTitle: Dispersion engineered cob-web photonic crystal fibers for efficient supercontinuum generation
abstract: Highly nonlinear cob-web photonic crystal fibers are engineered to have dispersion profiles for efficient direct degenerate four-wave mixing and optimized supercontinuum generation with low-power picosecond pulses. This process is robust to fiber irregularities.

articleTitle: Impact of traffic behaviour on the planning of multilayer transport networks
abstract: The studies in this paper show that dynamic traffic requires network resources to be significantly overprovisioned. Complex optimisation algorithms used during network planning have less impact on network performance compared to the static traffic case.

articleTitle: Radiation tuning of birefringence in polarization maintaining optical fibers
abstract: We report permanent increase in birefringence of a polarization maintaining fiber when exposed to actinic radiation. We further demonstrate the application of this effect in tuning a PM fiber based optical filter.

articleTitle: Interference-based optical MEMS filters
abstract: In this paper we describe tunable interference filters based on arrays of MEMS micromirrors. A simple analytical description of the height distribution of micromirrors needed to create a desired spectral response is presented, and the implications on the design and utility of MEMS interference filters are discussed. Finally we describe two practical filter implementations. The first enables continuous spectral control over relatively broad bands, and the second is designed for wavelength-division-multiplexed fiber optic communication systems.

articleTitle: Nanosecond switching time, uncooled, zero frequency DWDM source
abstract: Ultra fast (< 12 ns, electronics limited) zero frequency error wavelength switching between 30 channels of a dense wavelength division multiplex source is demonstrated using widely tuneable lasers with optical injection phase lock loop control.

articleTitle: Novel header processing technique and wavelength routing performance of an optical packet switch with a multibit optical digital-to-analog conversion-type header processor
abstract: Processing technique for a multibit optical digital-to-analog converter by processing every two-bits is proposed. Wavelength routing performance of an optical packet switch with four-bit optical header processor was realized.

articleTitle: Wafer-scale replication of optical components on VCSEL wafers
abstract: Microoptical structures on top of various substrates and optoelectronic devices like VCSELs are demonstrated in a wafer-scale process combining uv-casting and lithography. Some optical properties of the replicated refractive lenses are presented.

articleTitle: Zero chirp broadband Z-cut LiNbO/sub 3/ optical modulator using polarization reversal and branch electrode
abstract: A novel single drive Z-cut Ti-diffused LiNbO/sub 3/ modulator with a small chirp parameter less than 0.02 was demonstrated using polarization reversal and branch electrode. The modulator showed preferable 10 Gb/s eye-opening and bias stability.

articleTitle: Compact, spectrally smooth, nanosecond infrared continuum source with 700 nm bandwidth
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of a 700-nm-wide, nanosecond, infrared continuum using a compact, passively Q-switched laser pumped by a 1.2 W diode and a novel photonic crystal fiber with zero dispersion near 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Polymer waveguides for optoelectronic devices, packaging and interconnects
abstract: Recent developments and applications of polymer waveguides will be reviewed in the areas of devices, packaging and high speed board interconnects.

articleTitle: Actively mode-locked fiber laser employing a highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber for intracavity nonlinear pulse compression
abstract: Actively mode-locked fiber laser, which employs polarization-maintaining photonic crystal fiber (PM-PCF) with high nonlinearity and dispersion for intracavity nonlinear pulse compression is shown. The laser produced 1.26-ps pulses at 10-GHz-rate using PM-PCF of only 10-m-long.

articleTitle: Traveling-wave electrode electroabsorption modulators toward 100 Gb/s
abstract: We present segmented traveling-wave electroabsorption modulators matched to 50 /spl Omega/. The devices show excellent high frequency performance up to 50 GHz, and exhibit a maximum model-extrapolated 3 dBe bandwidth of 90 GHz. Clear eye openings at 50 Gbit/s are presented.

articleTitle: A new traffic aggregation concept in all-optical wavelength routed networks
abstract: We propose and evaluate a new concept of traffic aggregation in mesh networks that aims to eliminate the bandwidth underutilization problem existing in all-optical wavelength routed networks.

articleTitle: Metro WDM network with photonic domains
abstract: We introduce the concept of photonic domains and apply it to metro WDM ring networks. Wavelengths are reused in different domains. OUPSR and shared protections can be implemented.

articleTitle: Simultaneous noncontact fiber tension and diameter measurement using Fourier domain optical coherence tomography
abstract: The diameter and tension of an optical fiber are simultaneously measured using Fourier domain optical coherence tomography. This technique does not perturb the fiber and it may potentially be applied during the fiber draw process.

articleTitle: Photonic packet router for 40-Gbit/s 16-bit burst optical packets
abstract: A novel photonic packet router for 40-Gbit/s 16-bit burst optical packets has been developed using serial-to-parallel and parallel-to-serial converters, optical clock-pulse generators, and a 4/spl times/4 CMOS-based processor with label swapping, switching, and buffering functions.

articleTitle: The development of hollow core waveguides for in telecommunications, sensors, and laser power delivery
abstract: 1D-hollow waveguides with a single central hole coated on the inside with metallic and/or dielectric coatings are capable of transmitting broadband visible to far infrared radiation for telecom, chemical sensing, and kilowatt laser power delivery.

articleTitle: Quantum limits for receiver sensitivity with coding
abstract: We connect the quantum limits for receiver sensitivity to the Shannon channel capacity and identify the corresponding quantum limits for direct-detection on-off keying modulation with forward error correction codes.

articleTitle: Transient control in RFAs for multi-pumping environments by using a multi-objective optimization approach
abstract: We present a control strategy for transient gain response in counter-pumped Raman fiber amplifiers, in which the controllers' parameters are tuned by using genetic algorithms in order to obtain overall stability of the system.

articleTitle: Novel glass system with negative temperature coefficient of refractive index and its application to arrayed waveguide grating
abstract: We demonstrated an athermal arrayed waveguide grating by using a novel glass system with TiO/sub 2/ concentration of more than 50 mol%. We reduced the temperature coefficient of the center wavelength to less than 1 pm//spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Phase sensitive optical low coherence reflectometry (OLCR) with amplitude measurements only
abstract: Complex impulse response is measured by having a tunable source for an amplitude sensitive OLCR. The new technique is demonstrated through experiments and numerical simulations for fiber gratings and arrayed waveguide gratings.

articleTitle: Wavelength-switching single-longitudinal-mode fiber ring laser based on cascaded composite Sagnac loop filters
abstract: Composite fiber Sagnac loop filters are cascaded to demonstrate a high finesse transmission spectrum for an electro-optical wavelength-switching fiber ring laser. Stable single longitudinal mode operation is also achieved by employing Sagnac loop saturable absorber filter.

articleTitle: LiNbO/sub 3/: where do we go from here?
abstract: This presentation explores new process technologies, devices, and applications of LiNbO/sub 3/ developed since its first commercial success-the traveling wave modulator. Topics range from thin film growth to entangled photon sources-and their potential impact on communications and sensor systems.

articleTitle: Impact of device characteristics on network performance from a physical-impairment-based routing algorithm
abstract: We demonstrate the impact of optical switch, amplifier and MUX/DEMUX characteristics on optical network performance evaluated from our physical-impairment-based RWA algorithm. We present blocking probabilities as a function of traffic load and network device parameters.

articleTitle: Ensuring stability of GMPLS signaling via coordinated multi-layer recovery
abstract: We investigate issues regarding stability of the GMPLS signaling protocol based on RSVP extensions. We examine possible chains of events that lead to instabilities. We recommend guidelines for GMPLS protocol implementation to ensure protocol stability.

articleTitle: Characterization of chromatic dispersion using gated amplified spontaneous emission
abstract: Chromatic dispersion is characterized using temporally-gated amplified spontaneous emission. The group delay is directly obtained using interferometry and Fourier processing as a continuous function of the optical frequency over the full bandwidth of the source.

articleTitle: Large capacity contents handling over optical networks: motion pictures on optical networks
abstract: Content handling has been dramatically advanced by content digitalization and network usage. Several features of content handling are described and some examples of postproduction of film contents and their distribution over optical networks are introduced.

articleTitle: Planar lightwave circuit eight-channel CWDM multiplexer
abstract: We demonstrate a novel eight-channel CWDM multiplexer. The fully-packaged channel losses range from 3.1 dB to 5.5 dB, the 1-dB bandwidth is 16.5 nm, and the crosstalk is <-26 dB. This silica-waveguide device could have very low cost.

articleTitle: Optical biosensors: applying photonics products to biomedical diagnostics market
abstract: There is a tremendous need for new tools to tame modern health problems that harness the incredible breakthroughs in bio-chemical research. We elaborate on how photonics techniques developed recently could address this need.

articleTitle: Complex fiber grating structures fabricated by using polarization control of the UV exposure beam
abstract: We propose two flexible methods for fabricating complex fiber grating structures based on the polarization control of the UV exposure beam. Pure apodized and arbitrary phase-shifted fiber gratings can be fabricated in a single scan.

articleTitle: Microring coupled-resonator optical waveguides
abstract: We use transfer matrices to obtain the dispersion relations of microring coupled-resonator optical waveguides (CROWs). We also analyze pulse propagation through finite and semi-infinite microring CROWs. The results agree well with FDTD simulations.

articleTitle: Nonlinear amplifiers and fiber processing devices
abstract: Fiber optical parametric amplifiers are overviewed. After brief introduction of parametric amplification, operation mechanism of phase-sensitive amplifiers and various issues in phase-insensitive amplifiers are described. Applications to processing devices are also mentioned.

articleTitle: Form birefringence of fiber Bragg gratings due to exposure anisotropy
abstract: Fiber birefringence is induced during UV exposure because of absorption and beam focusing. Both effects have a small, comparable magnitude and opposite signs. Form birefringence does not explain the observed polarization dependence of FBGs.

articleTitle: CWDM vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser array spanning 140 nm of the C, S, and L fiber transmission bands
abstract: We demonstrate record wavelength span from an 8-channel WDM VCSEL array operating CW to 65/spl deg/C from 1470 to 1610 nm with precise 20-nm channel spacing. Devices are fabricated using nonplanar wafer bonding and fully-oxidized DBRs.

articleTitle: Trends in the architectural design and computer modeling of optical metropolitan area networks
abstract: We review the latest progress in the architectural design and the performance modeling of transparent, optical metropolitan area networks. We identify key transmission impairments, which affect the performance of these networks.

articleTitle: Transients in Raman amplifiers
abstract: Transient effects in Raman optical amplifiers have been demonstrated and modeled recently. We will review the advances in areas related to the dynamics of Raman amplifiers.

articleTitle: Integrated 32ch dynamic wavelength channel selector using AWG and 32 /spl times/ 1 PLC switch
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated 32ch dynamic wavelength channel selector consisting of an AWG and a 32 /spl times/ 1 switch using PLC technology. The crosstalk is less than -35 dB, we successfully obtained a loss variation of only /spl plusmn/ 0.1 dB.

articleTitle: Improved technique for tracking of principal states of polarization and OSNR monitoring
abstract: An improved technique for tracking principal states of polarization (PSP) independent of the effect of ASE noise was demonstrated. It was also demonstrated that the improved OSNR monitoring methods using this technique reduce effects of PMD and extinction ratio of PBS. The methods showed an OSNR measurement error of less than 0.8 dB even in presence of large PMD.

articleTitle: Spectral shaping line codes for instant upgrade of existing passive optical networks
abstract: Novel line codes combined with WDM techniques allow simple and cost-effective overlay of higher bit-rate services in existing fiber optical access networks. The solution leaves the existing services and field-deployed fiber untouched.

articleTitle: All-optical half adder using a PPLN waveguide and an SOA
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical half adder for bit-wise addition of two data streams that simultaneously generates SUM and CARRY (XOR and AND operations, respectively). Error free operation for 27 bits with 2 dB power-penalty is reported.

articleTitle: Impact of SRS-induced crosstalk for different modulation formats in WDM systems
abstract: In this paper we investigate the combined effect of SRS crosstalk and GVD on amplitude and phase shift keyed modulation formats considering RZ and NRZ pulse shaping.

articleTitle: Offset-DQPSK modulation format for 40 Gb/s and comparison to RZ-DQPSK in WDM environment
abstract: We propose offset-DQPSK as a modified DPSK modulation format. The receiver sensitivity (Monte-Carlo simulations), the dispersion tolerance and the robustness towards nonlinear effects are investigated and compared with RZ-DQPSK.

articleTitle: Development of specifications for high-speed short-reach parallel multimode fiber interconnects
abstract: We review recent developments in short-reach optical fiber communications standards directed toward parallel optics applications enabled by laser-optimized multimode fiber and high-speed VCSELs.

articleTitle: A non-unitary transfer matrix method for practical analysis of race-track micro-resonator waveguide devices
abstract: We report that a non-unitary transfer matrix method that we have developed is effective in analyzing race-track resonator devices. The track-length dependence, not obvious in the U-TM analysis, is clearly shown in the NU-TM analysis.

articleTitle: Impairments induced by binary-phase pump modulation in fiber parametric amplifiers
abstract: Binary-phase-shift-keyed pump modulation suppresses stimulated Brillouin scattering in fiber parametric devices. However, both one- and two-pump parametric architectures exhibit excess idler broadening that increases as the rise and fall times of the pump-modulation decrease.

articleTitle: Novel line-by-line apodization method for scribed channel-waveguide Bragg gratings
abstract: We demonstrate a novel apodization method for channel-waveguide Bragg gratings. Photolithographically-enabled control of reflective amplitude and phase of individual grating-constituent elements yields devices providing steep-roll-off, flat-top filtering, high (Fourier-transform-limited) resolution, and multipassband spectral decoding.

articleTitle: Design issues for time sliced optical burst
abstract: We study the design of components required to build time sliced optical burst switched (TSOBS) routers. We present a cost analysis of TSOBS routers showing that TSOBS routers can potentially become cost-competitive with electronic routers.

articleTitle: 1550-nm superprism demultiplexers in 2-D silicon-on-insulator slabs
abstract: Superprism phenomena are demonstrated in the 1550 nm range with SOI-based 2D photonic crystal slab. An angular swing of up to 10/spl deg/ is observed as the input wavelength is changed from 1528 nm to 1557 nm.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse timing measurement using an ultrafast organic molecular film and a computational sensor array
abstract: We demonstrate a precision pulse timing measurement technique using a molecular film of squarylium dye J-aggregate and a high-bandwidth computational sensor array to achieve high-density, parallel extraction of femtosecond optical pulses.

articleTitle: Nonlinear crosstalk and compensation in quaternary differential-phase amplitude-shift-keying transmission
abstract: Nonlinear crosstalk for quaternary differential-phase ASK modulation is analyzed. Significant crosstalk penalty is measured for nonlinear phase shifts of 0.4 rad and above. A compensating technique is proposed and demonstrated, increasing the tolerance by 4.3 dB.

articleTitle: A short fibre amplifier based on Er/sup 3+/ doped tellurite glass
abstract: The gain characteristics in Er/sup 3+/ and Er/sup 3+//Ce/sup 3+/ codoped tellurite fibres using 976 nm pump have been investigated. Gain at 1.53 /spl mu/m increased from 16 dB to 31 dB in a 12 cm long fibre.

articleTitle: Birefringence as a function of upper-cladding sub-layers in polymeric waveguides
abstract: Polarization-dependent wavelength shifts in polymeric arrayed-waveguide gratings are found to be a function of the number of upper-cladding sublayers with a positive offset and a negative slope depending on the thickness of the sublayers.

articleTitle: A fiber-based, high-power supercontinuum light source
abstract: High-power supercontinuum generation, based on a highly nonlinear fiber pumped by a continuous-wave Raman fiber laser, is reported. Output powers as high as 3.2 W and bandwidths greater than 544 nm are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: SNR degradations by lumped and distributed reflections in wide bandwidth EDFA based systems
abstract: Impact of reflections on SNR in single-stage EDFA based long-haul communication systems is investigated numerically and experimentally. Necessity of EDFA's input isolator and return losses of passive elements are discussed.

articleTitle: Reducing the cost of upgrade for high-PMD cable with the help of distributed PMD measurement
abstract: With a P-OTDR, we have tested many fibers of a cable and found that the high-PMD contributors were localized within a given region, showing that a partial replacement of the cable is possible.

articleTitle: Accurate non destructive measurement of the extinction wavelength of the second mode of air-silica microstructure fibers
abstract: The second mode extinction wavelength of air-silica microstructure optical fibers is measured by means of a method based on the azimuthal analysis of the far-field at the fiber exit. The fiber curvature influence is characterized.

articleTitle: Optical add/drop multiplexers based on autocloned photonic crystals
abstract: Photonic-crystal (PC)-based optical add/drop multiplexers (OADMs) were fabricated by autocloning for the first time. In these OADMs, a two-dimensional PC structure forms the channel waveguides and a three-dimensional PC structure forms a Bragg reflector. The obtained drop bandwidth of the OADMs is 2 nm.

articleTitle: Small-footprint thermocapillary optical switch with a heater array on a CMOS IC chip
abstract: We propose a hybrid structure combining a planar lightwave circuit chip and CMOS IC chip to achieve a compact switch fabric and demonstrate a new 16/spl times/16-size matrix thermocapillary optical switch fabricated based on this concept.

articleTitle: Tutorials
abstract: Provides an abstract for each of the tutorial presentations and a brief professional biography of each presenter. The complete presentations were not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Fibre DFB lasers with ultimate efficiency
abstract: A novel method for designing DFB lasers with ultimate efficiency is presented. A 57% efficiency increase over standard optimised Er-Yb codoped fibre designs is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: 20-Gbit/s all-optical XOR gate by four-wave mixing in semiconductor optical amplifier with RZ-DPSK modulated inputs
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical XOR gate at 20-Gbit/s using FWM in an SOA, with RZ-DPSK modulated input signals. The scheme is inherently simple, robust, and free of pattern effect. It is feasible for ultrahigh-speed operation.

articleTitle: Structural detuning of pump absorption rate in doped fiber for the enhancement of power conversion efficiency
abstract: We propose a novel doped fiber structure along with its design criteria, for the enhancement of power conversion efficiency in L-band erbium doped fiber amplifier. With proper adjustments on doping profiles for the reduction of pump absorption rate, it becomes possible to optimize pump evolution map inside the doped fiber to get better power efficiency, while suppressing the development of pump-depleting, detrimental ASE. Exemplary analysis shows significant enhancement in the saturation output power of more than 2.0 dB, when compared to conventional doping profiles.

articleTitle: EDFA-based coupled opto-electronic oscillator and its phase noise
abstract: EDFA-based coupled opto-electronic oscillator (COEO), an integrated optical and microwave oscillator that can generate picosecond optical pulses, is presented. The phase noise measurements of COEO show better performance than synthesizer-driven mode-locked laser.

articleTitle: Effective suppression of signal-wavelength transients in a pump-controlled L-band EDFA
abstract: Pump-controlled L-band EDFAs in feed-forward scheme give significant transients due to gain difference on wavelength of input signal when only a few channels are left. The fiber-Bragg-grating-added pump-controlled L-band EDFA eliminates the wavelength-dependent transients.

articleTitle: High-speed waveguide photodetectors
abstract: To achieve the high bandwidths required for 40 Gb/s (and higher) fiber optic receivers it will be necessary to abandon conventional single-pass, normal-incidence photodiodes in favor of waveguide structures. Some of the issues to be addressed as waveguide photodiodes are developed for high-bit-rate applications include input coupling, RF design, saturation at high current levels, and integration to improve performance and functionality.

articleTitle: Fabrication of silica-core photonic bandgap fiber with multilayer cladding
abstract: A new fabrication technique of a photonic bandgap fiber is proposed. The fiber involves dielectric multilayer deposited by sputtering technique and the bandgap property is easily controlled by thickness and index of the multilayer.

articleTitle: High performance semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: Recent developments in SOA technology and applications are reviewed.

articleTitle: Polysiloxane based optical splitters with low insertion loss fabricated through direct photolithography
abstract: Optical splitters with high resolution at Y branches have been fabricated through direct photolithography by using photosensitive polysiloxane based materials. The splitters showed low insertion losses with excellent uniformity at 1310 nm and 1550 nm.

articleTitle: All-fibre devices based on tapered fibres
abstract: Most attendees of OFC will be familiar with fused couplers, the ubiquitous all-fibre beamsplitter. This paper reviews the many other functions performed on light by fibres tapered through heating and stretching, and the all-fibre devices that result.

articleTitle: Planar echelle grating DWDM comb filters
abstract: We report a novel architecture for the design of DWDM comb filters based on planar echelle gratings. Two 100-GHz-period comb filters were realized yielding Gaussian and flat-top spectral responses with high extinction ratios.

articleTitle: Return-to-zero quaternary differential-phase amplitude-shift-keying for long-haul transmission
abstract: Return-to-zero (RZ) quaternary differential-phase ASK modulation with 20-Gb/s aggregate data-rate is implemented with both optical and electrical RZ pulse generation. A simple pre-chirping scheme is proposed to improve its nonlinear tolerance in long-haul transmission.

articleTitle: 10 Gbps and 2.5 Gbps error-free operation of a monolithically integrated widely-tunable all-optical wavelength converter with independent phase control output 35 nm tuning range
abstract: This paper reports on the first demonstration of 2.5 Gbps and 10 Gbps operation of a new InP MZI-SOA all-optical wavelength converter with independent interferometer phase control monolithically integrated with a widely-tunable SGDBR laser. We show a 35 nm output tuning range with less than 0.8 dB power penalty at-10 dBm input at 2.5 Gbps NRZ and error-free operation with -5dBm input power at 10 Gbps NRZ.

articleTitle: Ultra low loss and long length photonic crystal fiber
abstract: Photonic crystal fiber is a promising candidate for future transmission media due to its unobtainable features in a conventional single-mode fiber. We discuss some important problems to realize a PCF for transmission purpose.

articleTitle: 160 Gb/s regenerating conversion node
abstract: A single-polarization, 160 Gb/s RZ-DPSK-signal is transmitted over 240 km fiber, processed in a network node converting RZ-DPSK into OOK, 160 Gb/s into 40 Gb/s and the wavelength from 1551 nm to 1559 nm. The 40 Gb/s OOK-signal is transmitted error-free over additional 160 km SSMF.

articleTitle: Survivable virtual concatenation for data-over-SONET/SDH networks
abstract: We propose two approaches for provisioning survivable virtual-concatenated connections in data-over-SONET/SDH networks. Our approaches exploit the tradeoff between resource overbuild and protection-switching time while utilizing the route-splitting feature of virtual concatenation to increase backup sharing.

articleTitle: Verifying agile transparent system performance with field testing
abstract: This paper presents the results of field testing of one hundred 10 Gb/s channels, fully tunable, photonically switched 3000 km transport system. This is compared against expected results.

articleTitle: Demonstration of the improvement of apodized 127-chip SSFBG in coherent time-spreading OCDMA network
abstract: We for the first time report the apodized SSFBG en/decoder for coherent time-spreading OCDMA. The performance improvement of the apodized SSFBG with 127-chip, 160-Gchip/s, bipolar Gold code is demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Impact of SOA gain saturation and dynamics on the throughput of optical burst switching nodes
abstract: Signal degradation limits the size and the throughput of optical burst switching nodes. By considering SOA gain saturation and dynamics by simulations and experimentally together with noise and crosstalk, architectures of burst switches are analyzed.

articleTitle: Generation of optical pulse trains by repetition rate multiplications with cascaded long-period fiber gratings
abstract: Cascaded long-period fiber gratings are used to achieve multiplications of the repetition rate of pulse trains. The generated pulse trains have 2/spl times/, 4/spl times/, and 8/spl times/ multiplications, and the maximum achieved repetition rate is 416.7 GHz.

articleTitle: Outband optical modulation technique for measuring intrinsic dynamics of semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: A practical technique using outband optical intensity modulation is demonstrated for measuring an SOA's dynamic response for the first time. A significant difference in co- and counter-propagating the pump with signal is observed and explained.

articleTitle: 7.3 dB increase of the SBS threshold in an optical fiber by applying a strain distribution
abstract: We study experimentally and numerically the increase of the SBS-threshold in a 500 m-DS fiber by applying two different strain distributions. A stair ramp distribution permits us to experimentally demonstrate a 7.3 dB SBS-threshold increase.

articleTitle: Novel scalable wavelength-converting crossbar
abstract: We introduce novel scalable wavelength-converting crossbar switches based on two-dimensional compact integration of quantum well waveguide modulators and surface-normal photodiodes. We demonstrate electrically-reconfigurable 2/spl times/2 arrays that perform unconstrained wavelength conversion in the entire 1530-1565 nm band.

articleTitle: Compensation of Raman transients in optical networks
abstract: Transients induced by channel interactions due to stimulated Raman scattering in dynamic channel loading scenarios degrade the performance of transparent optical networks. Different compensation concepts were analyzed and compared numerically. Successful suppression of Raman transients below acceptable limits could be demonstrated.

articleTitle: OTDM add-drop multiplexer based on XPM-induced wavelength shifting in highly nonlinear fiber
abstract: OTDM add-drop multiplexing at 80 Gb/s has been demonstrated with a simple and robust 50 m highly nonlinear fiber based (de)multiplexer. The scheme employs cross-phase modulation induced wavelength shifting with subsequent optical filtering.

articleTitle: A new heuristic for finding the shortest path with a disjoint counterpart
abstract: We describe a new heuristic for finding a shortest active path with a disjoint backup path (the Min-Min problem), which works better than other heuristics and is also a viable approach for shared path protection.

articleTitle: All optical shutter based on Raman-assisted four-wave mixing in dispersion shifted fiber
