abstract: We demonstrated a 10 Gb/s all-optical shutter based on Raman-assisted four-wave-mixing in dispersion-shifted fiber. Improvement of more than 65 dB in the conversion efficiency and 26 dB in the signal-to-background ratio are obtained.

articleTitle: FBG based optical code en/decoder for long distance transmission without dispersion compensating devices
abstract: We demonstrate the optical code encoder/decoder for long distance transmission by optimising the characteristics of FBGs and designing the FBGs array configuration. Thus we demonstrated the 40 km transmission of 10 Gbit/s signals without dispersion compensating devices.

articleTitle: PMD distribution measurement with polarimetric OTDR assuming nonspherical Rayleigh backscattering
abstract: We demonstrated comparison of polarisation mode dispersion (PMD) distribution among DSF's with/without spin during fiber-drawing, based on p-OTDR Jones matrix eigen analysis (JME) method which were consistent with JME standard measurement using transmission n-type polarimetry.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave-band amplitude-shift-keyed radio-on-fiber signal generation with a reciprocating optical modulator
abstract: We demonstrated binary amplitude-shift-keyed modulated millimeter-wave signal generation using a reciprocating optical modulator. Due to interference effect of reciprocating lightwaves, ASK of 52.8-GHz signal was achieved by low-voltage (2.0 V) base-band signal, where V/sub /spl pi// was 6.4 V.

articleTitle: Polarization dependent gain due to signal-signal Raman interaction: can fiber PMD be too low?
abstract: Polarization dependent gain (PDG) due to signal-signal Raman interaction (SSRI) has been investigated for the first time. We found that PDG can be more than 0.4 dB/span for an 80-channel C-band WDM system when the fiber PMD is lower than 0.04 ps/km/sup 1/2/.

articleTitle: Cost-conscious impairment-aware routing
abstract: We present a method for impairment-aware routing in transparent networks that allows constraint dependencies and objectives minimizing regeneration cost. The method is guaranteed to identify impairment-feasible paths when they exist and uses transponder resources efficiently.

articleTitle: High-order PMD and PDL emulator
abstract: A high-order combined PMD/PDL emulator is constructed using low-cost fiber Bragg grating taps. The PMD/PDL auto-correlation and DGD statistics are investigated as a metric for how ideal the emulator is. System impact is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-channel-count comb filter with a simple structure
abstract: Based on the analysis of comb filter formed by highly chirped sampled Bragg grating, a 36-channel comb filter is fabricated with 28 nm bandwidth, 0.31 nm channel bandwidth (0.5 dB), >22 dB adjacent channel isolation and <0.4 dB insertion loss.

articleTitle: Scheduling algorithms for shared-fiber-delay-line optical cell switches
abstract: In a shared-fiber-delay-line (shared-FDL) optical cell switch, delayed cells must be assigned delay values and FDL routes before entering the switch. We propose three new cell scheduling algorithms for the shared-FDL optical cell switches.

articleTitle: All-optical multichannel simultaneous up-conversion for microwave fiber-optic link
abstract: We report all-optical multichannel signal up-conversion using difference frequency generation in a quasi-phase-matched LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguide device. Link performance for 20-GHz optical microwave system was examined with three 1-Gbit/s data streams and error-free transmission was achieved.

articleTitle: A comparison of electronic and optical packet/burst switching fabrics
abstract: In this paper, different approaches are analyzed from routers to networks comparing electronics versus optics. Advantages and drawbacks in different introduction scenarios are drawn to identify what are the next challenges for multi-terabit class packet routers.

articleTitle: Very high negative chromatic dispersion in a dual concentric core photonic crystal fiber
abstract: A photonic crystal fiber (PCF) based on a particular periodic arrangement of air holes is designed for chromatic dispersion compensation. A two concentric cores structure is obtained and exhibits very high negative chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: Realization of all-optical flip-flop based on bistable laser diode with active multimode interference cavity
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an all-optical flip-flop using a multimode interference bistable laser diode. It is based on bistable switching between two cross-coupled lasing modes. Pulse width conversion experiment and operation speed assessment are also presented.

articleTitle: Three-level fiber DFB laser at 980 nm
abstract: A three-level fiber DFB-laser operating at 977 nm is demonstrated for the first time using a 910 nm pump diode. The fiber DFB laser shows 17.5 mW output power under a launching power of 113 mW.

articleTitle: Direct UV-written integrated optical components
abstract: Direct UV writing is an emerging method for flexible, low cost fabrication of integrated optical waveguides and components. The performance of UV written components can be similar to that achieved with more elaborate fabrication techniques.

articleTitle: Advances in diode laser pumps for Raman amplification
abstract: Advanced 14xx-nm-pump-lasers are reviewed for next generation optical fiber amplifiers. Hybrid-pump with ultra high power and low-DOP, uncooled pump for submarine system, and inner-grating-multi-mode-laser (IGM-laser) with ultra low noise and reduced stimulated-Brillouin-scattering are described.

articleTitle: Cyberinfrastructure and large-scale network testbeds
abstract: Historically, testbeds have played a pivotal role in the advancement of networking research, accelerating the progression from early design and prototyping to broader deployment and operational insertion. This talk will describe some of the major NSF-supported testbed network efforts aimed at serving the scientific and engineering community.

articleTitle: Optimum soft-decision FEC thresholds for on-off optical receiver using block turbo code
abstract: The optimum thresholds for a 3-bit soft-decider are investigated analytically for the first time. A theoretical prediction is verified by experiment, using a live evaluation circuit comprising a 10 Gb/s optical transceiver with a BTC encoder.

articleTitle: Metropolitan service provider business model for profitability
abstract: The paper discusses on the factors which contribute to service provider success. Some factors include building access, owning/controlling fiber backbone and delineation of costs, assets and customer service. These factors have proven to be even more important than the multi-service offering. Infrastructure issues were the undoing of a number of companies.

articleTitle: Performance of OSNR monitor based on polarization-nulling technique in aerial fiber link
abstract: We evaluated the performance of an OSNR monitor based on the polarization-nulling technique in a 120-km long aerial fiber link. Despite of the fast and slow fluctuations in state of polarization in aerial fiber, OSNR was measured within an accuracy of better than /spl plusmn/1 dB.

articleTitle: Signal processing on PMD SIMO channels
abstract: A single-input multiple-output polarization mode dispersion channel model is proposed based on the principal state model. Linear equalizer and decision feedback equalizer are developed based on the model, which can mitigate all orders of PMD effectively.

articleTitle: Modular wavelength selective cross-connects
abstract: Optical cross-connects are an enabling technology for transparent mesh networking, but are better implemented in modular fashion for economic benefits. Various cross-connect constructs are reviewed and found that using wavelength-selective switches offers the greatest advantages.

articleTitle: 64/spl times/64 3D-MEMS switch control system with robustness to MEMS resonant frequency variation and pointing drift
abstract: We have demonstrated a 64/spl times/64 3D-MEMS optical crossconnect with a switching servo control system that is robust to mirror resonant frequency variations and pointing drift, resulting in typical switching times of less than 20 ms.

articleTitle: 160 Gbit/s all-optical limiter based on spectrally filtered optical solitons
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical limiting of a 160-Gbit/s OTDM signal by using spectrally filtered optical solitons. Signal input power tolerance for improving Q-factors is 3.6 dB. Q-factors after 230 km transmission were improved by 1.8 dB.

articleTitle: MEMS-tunable 10 Gb/s APD receiver for broadcast and select CATV networks
abstract: A 10 Gb/s receiver combining a MEMS-tunable optical filter and avalanche photodiode in a common butterfly provides tuning over 5 THz with -26 dBm receiver sensitivity and /spl plusmn/5 GHz wavelength control, to enable dynamic provisioning for broadcast and select CATV networks.

articleTitle: Wavelength tuning of photonic crystal waveguides fabricated using 248-nm deep UV lithography
abstract: Wavelength tuning of characteristic features of straight photonic crystal waveguides has been obtained by varying the exposure dose in deep UV lithography. The experimental results agree very well with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Spectral broadening and intensity interactions in cascades of a Raman fiber laser: analytical model and experimental test
abstract: Spectral broadening and its influence on the output power and intensity interactions in cascades of a Raman fiber laser has been studied experimentally and theoretically. The effect appears very important for the RFL optimal performance.

articleTitle: All-optical phase construction of ps-pulses from fiber lasers for coherent signaling at ultra-high data rates (/spl ges/160 Gb/s)
abstract: A novel method to reconstruct the optical phase of fiber laser data pulses allows for generating phase-coded signal formats at record high speed (up to 320 Gb/s). This enables the first-time analysis of nonlinear transmission properties of different coherent modulation formats at 160-Gb/s.

articleTitle: 14xx nm pumped thulium-doped fiber amplifier bursty traffic applications
abstract: Upconversion pumping in the 1400 nm-range gives thulium-doped fiber amplifier (TDFA) a dynamic range of 15 dB, and transient power excursion much lower than conventional erbium-doped fiber amplifier during dynamic wavelength add-drop. Hence, it is promising for bursty traffic applications.

articleTitle: Demultiplexers with /spl sim/10 pm (1.25 GHz) -3dB transmission bandwidth using a virtually imaged phased array (VIPA)
abstract: We demonstrate 12-17 pm and 7-9 pm linewidth for the virtually imaged phased array wavelength demultiplexer with 100 GHz and 50 GHz free spectral range respectively. We also present the first analytic theory for the linewidth.

articleTitle: Transmission capacity study using cost effective undersea system technology with 120 km repeater spacing
abstract: We demonstrate a cost-effective undersea system design with 120 km repeater spacing supporting sixty-four 10 Gbit/s channels in 17 nm bandwidth over 4800 km and present a detailed study of transmission performance versus distance.

articleTitle: Is photonic crystal technology commercially viable?
abstract: The commercial viability of planar photonic crystals as a platform for photonic integration in telecommunication networks is discussed. We consider the required specifications and the challenges faced by companies intent on commercializing photonic crystal technology.

articleTitle: High-sensitivity high-resolution sampling using linear optics and waveguide optical hybrid
abstract: A practical sampling setup based on linear interference of an optical signal with a sampling pulse in a waveguide optical hybrid demonstrates record-sensitivity sampling of eye diagrams up to 640 Gb/s with high fidelity.

articleTitle: Pade approximation for improved split-step methods
abstract: Using Pade approximations to the exponential function, an improved split-step method for the nonlinear Schrodinger equation is presented. For accurate simulations of large DWDM systems, substantial speed-up factors over the split-step Fourier method are obtained.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact 52 mW 50-GHz spaced 16 channels narrow-line and single-polarization fiber laser
abstract: The multiwavelength laser is based on a 41 mm long distributed Fabry-Perot resonator photo-induced in Er-Yb codoped fiber using superimposed chirped gratings. With a single pump laser, the mean power per line is 5.1 dBm.

articleTitle: Fair queuing with service envelopes (FQSE): a cousin-fair hierarchical scheduler for Ethernet PONs
abstract: Non-hierarchical algorithms are not scalable for scheduling in EPON, while hierarchical algorithms do not provide fairness among the end consumers. This study presents a novel hierarchical EPON scheduler, which guarantees fairness among all subscribers.

articleTitle: Efficient physical topologies for regular WDM networks
abstract: In this paper, we study the design of efficient physical topology of WDM network by building an analytical framework to find optimal connectivity of the regular networks as network sizes and traffic volume scale.

articleTitle: High tensile strength photonic crystal
abstract: PCFs can have a higher tensile strength than conventional silica fibers because the holes prevent flaws from growing. A proper designed PCF shows a tensile strength of 7 kgf which is unobtainable with commercial SMF.

articleTitle: Water-core microstructure fiber for optical sensing
abstract: A novel type of sensor fiber has an aqueous core surrounded by a microstructured silica-air cladding. Simulations demonstrate single-mode, low-loss operation and nearly perfect overlap with the sample over a wide wavelength range.

articleTitle: Longitudinal distribution of stress along the splice between dissimilar optical fibers
abstract: We report detailed axial stress distribution along the splice between dissimilar optical fibers. Variation in magnitude, sign as well as discontinuity in the stress distribution were experimentally analyzed for splicing DCF, DSF and EDF with SMF.

articleTitle: Novel optical sampling oscilloscope without traditional trigger technique and measurement of optical short pulse modulated PRBS pattern
abstract: We have developed a novel optical sampling oscilloscope (OSO) that can measure an optical signal exceeding 160 Gbps without using a traditional trigger technique. We describe the first measurement in the persistence mode of a short pulse-modulated PRBS pattern with a jitter of 0.2 ps rms and a resolution of 1 ps.

articleTitle: Retiming of short optical pulses using linear pulse reshaping and all-optical switching
abstract: An all-optical, all-fiberized technique for the elimination of timing jitter in short pulse transmission systems is experimentally demonstrated. The technique is based on pulse shaping in a superstructured fiber Bragg grating and optical switching in a nonlinear optical loop mirror.

articleTitle: All-optical wavelength conversion based on pure optical phase modulation
abstract: We investigate a simple wavelength converter based on optical phase modulation. The scheme offers good efficiency, format- and bit-rate-independence and uses no local laser. Near penalty-free conversion, two-wavelength operation and a 100 nm operating range are confirmed.

articleTitle: Ultra high density and long haul transmissions
abstract: This paper reviews the recent advances in high spectral density, high-capacity and long-haul transmission technologies for terrestrial optical networks. It explains design and limitations, and discusses technical challenges for next-generation transparent optical networks.

articleTitle: Polarization-state-rotation and filtering receiver for bandwidth-efficient tandem single sideband systems
abstract: We demonstrate a novel, flexible receiver architecture for tandem, single-side-band subcarrier detection using a DGD element and polarizer for polarization-state-rotation and filtering. Independent sideband data is recovered with >35dB carrier-to-sideband suppression ratio.

articleTitle: Suppression of intra-channel nonlinear distortion in 40 Gbit/s transmission over standard single mode using alternate-phase RZ and alternate-polarisation
abstract: We show, for the first time, the suppression of intra-channel nonlinear distortion in 40 Gbit/s transmission by combining alternate-polarisation with the alternate-phase-RZ signal in an optical-time-division-multiplexed system, doubling the maximum transmission distance compared to standard RZ.

articleTitle: Towards the low limits of 1383 nm loss in PCVD enabled single mode fibre production
abstract: Based on a pilot development series it is shown that careful prevention of OH/sup -/ contamination in all PCVD process steps enables industrial production of SM fibres with a 1383 nm loss reaching below 0.30 dB/km.

articleTitle: Parametric amplification in optical fibers with random birefringence
abstract: By averaging the OPA equations for fibers with random birefringence, we show that the gain coefficient with orthogonal pumps is significantly larger than would be expected in nonbirefringent fibers. This is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: 100 Gbit/s wavelength conversion using MQW-EAM blueshifted absorption edge
abstract: 100 Gbit/s wavelength conversion using an MQW-EAM with a delayed-interferometer was demonstrated for the first time. The absorption edge of the MQW-EAM was blueshifted for the optimization to a high bit-rate operation.

articleTitle: WDM tuneable dispersion compensator with PLC ring resonators
abstract: We have developed operational tuneable dispersion compensator that has a tuning range of /spl plusmn/1000 ps/nm based on ring resonator using high-/spl Delta/ PLC technology. We have realized 1050 ps/nm dispersion compensation at 16 WDM channels simultaneously.

articleTitle: Fabrication of tunable photonic crystal fiber coupler
abstract: We report the fabrication of tunable photonic crystal fiber (PCF) coupler based on the side polishing technology. The PCF coupler was obtained by mating two side-polished PCFs embedded in quartz block. By adjusting the mating angle between the blocks, the coupling ratio could be adjusted from 0 to 90 percent. The spectrum of coupled light was rather flat over a 400 nm wavelength range with small ripples.

articleTitle: A comparison of measurement techniques for differential group delay in a long-haul optical system
abstract: We compare five methods for measuring the differential group delay (DGD) in a long-haul system. The commonly-used Jones matrix eigen analysis (JME) method is insensitive to polarisation dependent loss (PDL), but sensitive to Stokes noise. The other methods are more sensitive to PDL.

articleTitle: Practical applications of holey optical fibers
abstract: We review recent advances in the development of HF technology and describe various practical applications of the technology in the areas of nonlinear and active fiber devices.

articleTitle: Efficient segment-by-segment restoration
abstract: A dynamic approach is proposed for segment-by-segment restoration in intelligent optical networks. This approach significantly improves the failure restoration time whilst bounding the restoration path length and maintaining low bandwidth overbuild.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion characteristics of highly efficient fiber optic four-wave mixer for 160 GHz picosecond pulse train
abstract: We investigated wavelength conversion characteristics of 160 GHz pulse train in a wavelength converter based on four-wave mixing using highly nonlinear fiber. We observed modulation instability causes OSNR to degrade while conversion efficiency rapidly increases.

articleTitle: Tunable dispersion slope compensator using novel Gires-Tournois etalons
abstract: We present a novel concept of tailored Gires-Tournoise etalon structure and show that such devices are very useful for the realization of dispersion slope compensator with almost arbitrary dispersion profile and also with tunability in dispersion slope.

articleTitle: Single-mode etched-facet distributed Bragg reflector laser for uncooled operation
abstract: A novel AlGalnAs/InP single-mode laser was designed and fabricated using an etched-facet distributed Bragg reflector. It exhibits stable 1310 nm single-mode operation over a wide temperature range of 20 to 80/spl deg/C with high SMSR.

articleTitle: Study on the transient response of 1.059 /spl mu/m single- and 1.05/1.55 /spl mu/m dual-wavelength pumped TDFAs
abstract: We experimentally investigated the transient response of a dual-pumped TDFA. The amount of surviving channel gain, gain excursion and time-constants were analyzed. Two characteristic time-constants were observed and their values depend on the pumping combination.

articleTitle: Optical ASK/DPSK label encoding based on injection locking of Fabry-Perot laser diode
abstract: We demonstrate an optical-label encoding and swapping of a two-level optically-labeled signal using simultaneous ASK/DPSK orthogonal modulation for payload and label respectively. The bit-error-rate measurements for label and payload proved the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Optimal traffic grooming in WDM mesh networks under dynamic traffic
abstract: We consider the sparse placement of grooming-nodes in WDM mesh networks under dynamic traffic. We formulate the problem as a weighted minimum dominating set of graphs; and compare our scheme, via simulation, to known heuristics.

articleTitle: In-situ cleaning for highly reliable 1.3-/spl mu/m InGaAlAs buried heterostructure laser
abstract: An in-situ cleaned and regrown 1.3-/spl mu/m InGaAIAs buried heterostructure laser was fabricated for the first time. The degradation of its driving current was about 1% after a 2000-hour aging test.

articleTitle: Surface plasma CVD as a new technological platform for Er-doped waveguide amplifiers and lasers fabrication
abstract: Microwave-induced plasma chemical deposition is used to synthesize Er-doped nonfused glassy films. Silicate hosts with various additives are investigated. A high quantum yield of C-band luminescence is obtained at Er/sup 3+/ concentrations up to /spl sim/3/spl times/10/sup 20/cm/sup -3/.

articleTitle: Performance of a mostly Raman-amplified dispersion-managed fiber loop with polarization scrambling
abstract: We have investigated the system performance of a mostly Raman-amplified, polarization scrambled recirculating fiber loop. The lone EDFA characteristics dominate the Q-factor distributions, indicating the Raman amplification is not a source of polarization dependent impairments.

articleTitle: Polarization orthogonality preservation in DWDM cascaded arrayed-waveguide grating networks
abstract: We demonstrate polarization multiplexing in cascaded arrayed-waveguide grating (AWG) networks. In particular, AWG channel mapping and temperature fluctuations for different states of polarization were investigated and orthogonality degradation found to be small and additive.

articleTitle: Phase-modulation-shift-keying for fast dispersion compensation and optical labeling in optical packet switched networks
abstract: This work proposes phase-modulation-shift-keying, where sinusoidal phase modulation is put ON/OFF onto intensity modulated data according to digital label. Optical label is directly detected by adding dispersion. Packet-by-packet dispersion compensation can be achieved by this method.

articleTitle: Global expectation values of shared restoration capacity for general mesh networks
abstract: We establish analytical descriptions of extra capacity for shared mesh restoration of single link failures in mesh networks. These descriptions provide insight into the underlying dependencies allowing fast computation of the tradeoffs among survivability strategies.

articleTitle: Interworking DWDM equipment and PXC operation GMPLS for a reliable optical network
abstract: GMPLS interworking operation between DWDM equipment and PXC was demonstrated for the first time to achieve SONET/SDH-grade reliability. PXC has successfully initiated restoration and managed resources based on DWDM equipment information via control plane.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a wide band RF photonic transversal phase-shifter
abstract: A transversal phase-shifter using multiple MZMs is demonstrated. The device exhibits continuously variable phase-shift exceeding 360/spl deg/ at 2 GHz and amplitude uniformity within 3 dB over 0.2-2 GHz. The device stability and practicality are discussed.

articleTitle: Recent advances in thin film filters
abstract: Optical thin film filters are widely employed in optical communications systems. Important applications include narrowband filters for DWDM and gain flattening filters for EDFAs. Applications and recent advances in the technology are reviewed.

articleTitle: Uni-travelling-carrier photodiode performance with high optical power 10 Gb/s data
abstract: We have fabricated and characterized UTC-PDs and obtained average photocurrents exceeding 80 mA and record-high peak-to-peak voltages of 4.8 V over 50 /spl Omega/ at 10 Gb/s. The UTC-PD is further evaluated in an optically preamplified receiver, providing error-free operation.

articleTitle: Novel wavelength converter based on four-wave mixing inside a fiber Raman laser composed of a highly-nonlinear dispersion shifted fiber
abstract: Novel wavelength conversion technique by four-wave mixing inside a fiber Raman laser is proposed. By adopting highly-nonlinear dispersion shifted fibers, a high conversion efficiency and a wide conversion bandwidth are realized without an optical amplifier.

articleTitle: Dynamic path switching experiment for maximizing throughput on IP optical GMPLS test-bed network
abstract: We have developed experimental IP traffic driven dynamic switched optical path network composed of traffic monitors using network-processors and active-network technologies, optimal path search using genetic algorithm, IP reach-ability keep mechanism and optical switch systems.

articleTitle: Multirate payload switching using a swappable optical carrier suppressed label in a packet switched DWDM optical network
abstract: Optical packets with multirate payload are demonstrated for the first time for optical label switching and transport in a multihop optical network over 200 km fiber with low power penalty. The key functions will be demonstrated.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Raman crosstalk in a 125-Mb/s CWDM overlay on a 1310-nm video access network
abstract: Repeated idle frames from a 125 Mb/s line-rate fast Ethernet optical link generate a signal with RF spectral content peaked at 62.5 MHz and at its harmonics. We show, experimentally, that this modulation can be transferred from CWDM wavelengths (1430, 1450, 1470 nm...) to an analog video signal at 1310 nm via stimulated Raman crosstalk when the signals are co-propagating. However, no penalty is observed when the signals are counter propagating making CWDM overlay a viable solution to add services on a 1310 video access network.

articleTitle: Sprint's fiber to the home planning
abstract: Sprint planners realized a fiber to the home network has the potential to offer a compelling bundle of services today and the capability to offer unmatched suite of services. The cost of fiber to home network is less. Sprint has concluded that fiber to home is the bulk new growth method of choice that may shortly replace copper twisted pair cables as the standard network for all residential and small business customers.

articleTitle: Optical metro-access ring featuring a flexible color management
abstract: We propose a new optical metro-access ring concept featuring a flexible color management for efficient network operation. Experimental results show that 1 hub, up to 8 nodes and 80 Gbit/s capacity without optical amplification are achievable.

articleTitle: On optimal decision thresholds for soft-decision error correction decoding in fiberoptic communication systems
abstract: We propose a practical way for selecting multiple decision thresholds maximizing mutual information. We show that when soft-decision error correction performance approaches Shannon limit, optimal thresholds converge to the ones maximizing mutual information.

articleTitle: Installation and in-service OTDR testing for "Virtual Common Space:" a CWDM-based business access method
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a method for serving multiple independent "fiber-to-the-floor" customers in large buildings by using emerging CWDM equipment. We demonstrate installation and in-service testing techniques using CWDM OTDR, evaluating "signal-to-OTDR" and "OTDR-to-signal" impairments.

articleTitle: Simple criterion of quality to evaluate DCM impact on WDM system performance
abstract: We propose a simple criterion of quality for DCMs that takes into account both added-loss impact and nonlinear induced impairments in transmission systems. Optimization of next-generation DCMs should aim at maximizing this criterion.

articleTitle: Uncooled 40 Gb/s transmission over 40 km single mode fiber using multi-level modulation of a highly linear laser
abstract: An uncooled 1.3 micron directly modulated DFB laser is used to transmit 40 Gb/s multi-level data over 40 km of standard fibre. A semiconductor optical amplifier is used to overcome fibre loss and enhance transmission distance.

articleTitle: High-speed wavelength switching of 40-Gb/s-based WDM signals using a multiple-QPM LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguide tailored for the ITU-T grid
abstract: We achieved a variable wavelength conversion on the ITU-T grid using a multiple-quasiphase-matched LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguide. Using the device we demonstrated high-speed and simultaneous wavelength switching of 40-Gb/s-based WDM signals.

articleTitle: Compact 1/spl times/8 MEMS optical switches using planar lightwave circuits
abstract: A compact 1/spl times/8 optical switch is realized by directly butt-coupling a MEMS mirror to a planar lightwave circuit (PLC). A cylindrical microlens is microfabricated on PLC to reduce diffraction loss. A fiber-to-fiber loss of 6.3 dB is measured.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of a monolithically integrated InP-based waveguide isolator
abstract: A theoretically predicted concept for a monolithically integrated optical waveguide isolator is experimentally demonstrated for the first time. Preliminary non-reciprocity measurements indicate isolation ratios in the range of the design values, proving the device's potential.

articleTitle: Dispersion compensation fiber working in U band
abstract: To make full use of bandwidth source of fiber, dispersion compensation fiber (DCF) used in U band is developed. The bending performance in U band is kept well by optimizing the refractive index profile of DCF.

articleTitle: CSMA/CD-based Ethernet passive optical network with shared LAN capability
abstract: We propose the first physical layer solution of an Ethernet PON that offers shared LAN capability and upstream access. It features high channel utilization, relieves the processing burden on the OLT, and optimizes downstream capacity.

articleTitle: Key business and technical considerations in evaluating and selecting next-generation optical technology for network evolution
abstract: Innovation has continued through the telecom downturn. Evaluating and selecting which technology solutions provide greatest gain requires carriers to balance multiple business and technical considerations. This paper summarizes these considerations applied to long-haul transport space.

articleTitle: Impulse response compression for vector characterization of highly dispersive devices
abstract: The technique of impulse response compression is described, which allows coherent interferometric Jones matrix measurements of highly dispersive devices. The compressed impulse response also indicates an appropriate step size for group delay measurements.

articleTitle: Evanescently-coupled avalanche photodiodes integrating a short multimode waveguide for high-responsivity and high- speed applications
abstract: We demonstrate evanescently-coupled avalanche photodiodes utilizing a planar short multimode waveguide. These devices exhibit high-responsivity (> 0.62 A/W at unit gain), broad bandwidth (34.8 GHz at low gain) and 160 GHz gain-bandwidth product.

articleTitle: VCSELs emitting in the 1550 nm waveband with 0.6 mW single mode output in 20-80/spl deg/C temperature range
abstract: Wafer fused 7 /spl mu/m aperture InGaAlAs/AlGaAs VCSELs with InAlGaAs-based tunnel junction injection show record high 0.6 mW single mode output, 30 dB side-mode suppression ratio and 9/spl deg/ full width at half maximum in 20-80/spl deg/C temperature range.

articleTitle: Coherent homodyne detection using time-gated amplification and LiNbO/sub 3/ optical 90/spl deg/ hybrid
abstract: We investigated coherent detection of BPSK signal using LiNbO/sub 3/ optical 90/spl deg/ hybrid with pulsed and CW local-oscillator. Bit-error-rate improvement was observed using pulsed local-oscillator and it provides pulse shaping capability that reduces pulse broadening penalty.

articleTitle: Using tunable optical transceivers for reducing the number of ports in WDM/TDM networks
abstract: We consider the benefits of using tunable transceivers for reducing the required number of ports in WDM/TDM optical networks. We show that tunable transceivers can be used to efficiently "groom" subwavelength traffic and significantly reduce the number of ports compared to the fixed tuned case. We provide a new formulation for this "tunable grooming" problem and develop algorithms for designing such networks.

articleTitle: Hybridisation platform demonstrating all optical wavelength conversion at 10 and 20 Gbit/s
abstract: The development of a high performance hybrid integration platform is demonstrated using an all optical wavelength converter based on an integrated SOA MZI. The device structure, transfer functions, power penalties and regenerative properties are presented.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive single-pump optical parametric amplifier by depolarization of the pump
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization-insensitive single-pumped optical-parametric-amplifier by depolarizing the pump using a polarization controller followed by a piece of polarization-maintaining fiber with /spl sim/ 100-ps DGD. The polarization-dependent-gain is reduced from 8 dB to <1 dB.

articleTitle: Discharge power control for fusion splice of optical fiber
abstract: This paper concerns a novel method of minimizing loss and stabilizing fusion splicing performance under any atmospheric conditions. A feedback loop is used to relate the luminosity of the splice with arc current and time.

articleTitle: A novel method for evaluating the cutoff characteristic in a fiber with improved bending loss
abstract: A novel method for evaluating the effective cutoff characteristic in an optical fiber is described both numerically and experimentally. It is clarified that the proposed technique, which is based on far-field pattern measurement under different launching conditions, can be applied not only to conventional single-mode fiber but also to a fiber with improved bending loss.

articleTitle: A method of lifeline communication in passive optical network
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a lifeline communication for FTTH based on WDM-PON that has wavelength locked Fabry-Perot lasers as WDM sources.

articleTitle: Multiplexing of temperature-compensated FBG magnetostrictive sensors with a self-seeded laser diode
abstract: We present a technique for the multiplexing of temperature-compensated FBG magnetostrictive sensors. Interrogation of sensors is achieved by changing the driving RF frequency of a self-seeded laser diode configured to emit at two close wavelengths.

articleTitle: Intersubband transition all optical switches for 160 Gb-1 Tb/s OTDM systems
abstract: The authors are developing intersubband transition all-optical switch using the absorption saturation of InGaAs/AlAs/AlAsSb coupled double-quantum well (c-DQW). In their report, they will present their efforts to reduce the switching energy and the the-state-of-the-art performances of the developed optical switch.

articleTitle: Transmission of 1.6Tb/s (40/spl times/40 Gb/s) over 1,200km and three OADMs using 200-km SMF doubled-span with remotely pumped optical amplification
abstract: Potential of 200 km-SMF-span in a long-haul system with OADMs was evaluated. Adoption of remotely-pumped-optical-amplification enabled 1,200 km transmission of 1.6 Tb/s WDM signal with a simple dispersion map, which enabled OADMs to be inserted at any repeaters.

articleTitle: A novel optical phase locked loop architecture based on sub-carrier modulation
abstract: A novel sub-carrier based optical phase locked loop (SC-OPLL/spl trade/) is presented and demonstrated. Our method, based on CW laser and optical sub-carrier modulation, allows a much easier practical implementation of coherent detection than previous setups.

articleTitle: A new optical network architecture that exploits joint time and wavelength interleaving
abstract: This paper presents an optical network that provides fractional wavelength services without optical-to-electronic conversion. The architecture emulates fast switching in the passive network core through the use of ultra-fast wavelength tunable lasers at the edge.

articleTitle: Exact analysis for statistics of gain in counter-pumped Raman amplifier
abstract: We derived an analytical expression for the statistics of the polarization-dependent gain in a counter-pumped Raman amplifier and verified it with experimental and numerically simulated data. The results showed that the gain variation in a counter-pumped amplifier was only a factor of 3 smaller than that in a co-pumped scheme.

articleTitle: Expansion of passband of tunable chromatic dispersion compensator based on ring resonators using negative group delay peak
abstract: A method to expand passband of a novel tunable chromatic dispersion compensator (TCDC) based on ring resonator utilizing negative group delay peak was proposed and confirmed experimentally. Passband utilization of FSR exceeded 80%.

articleTitle: 1/spl times/N/sup 2/ wavelength-selective switches with high fill-factor two-axis analog micromirror arrays
abstract: A 1/spl times/N/sup 2/ wavelength-selective switch is demonstrated using a high fill-factor two-axis analog micromirror array and a monolithic 2D collimator array. A 1/spl times/2 (scalable to 1/spl times/14 ) WSS with 50-GHz channel spacing is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Characterization of four-wave mixing in electroabsorption modulator and its application to high-speed optical demultiplexing
abstract: Investigation of FWM in EAM shows wide tuning range with almost flat efficiency response. Enhancement of FWM efficiency with EAM reverse bias was observed. Simultaneous optical demultiplexing and wavelength conversion at 80 Gbit/s are demonstrated.

articleTitle: UV processing of highly nonlinear fibers for enhanced supercontinuum generation
abstract: We demonstrate that UV exposure of highly nonlinear germanosilicate fibers can significantly enhance the I-R supercontinuum generation in these fibers, extending it from 975 nm to 850 nm when pumped by 30 fs pulses at 1580 nm.

articleTitle: Fabrication of fiber collimate lens with liquid resin droplet
abstract: A new scheme for the fabrication of collimate lens for single mode fiber have been developed using liquid droplet of UV cured resin. A small amount of liquid resin is placed on the output surface of single mode fiber to form a collimate lens. The output beam from the fiber through this lens is monitored with a wave-front sensor. The centering error of the fiber position to the ferrule is adjusted by changing the tilt angle of the whole system to the gravity. The focus length is adjusted by the amount of resin to form a well-collimated beam when the resin is cured. A low cost plastic ferrule is developed using liquid crystalline polymer (LCP) with a large tolerance of fiber centering. The wave-front error of output beam is better than /spl lambda//4, and the coupling loss to a well-collimated beam is better than 0.9 dB without surface coating on the lens.

articleTitle: Tutorials
abstract: Summary form only given. Provides an abstract for each of the two keynote presentations and a brief professional biography of each presenter.

articleTitle: Multichannel polarization mode dispersion compensator and mitigator
abstract: For the first time, series connected optical components are deployed for polarization mode dispersion compensation at two arbitrary wavelengths. Simulations show a significant decrease of outage probabilities using the proposed structures.

articleTitle: Narrow bandwidth filtering of coherent and OTDM-generated 160 Gb/s data signals
abstract: We investigate narrow bandwidth filtering of 160 Gb/s signals with and without optical phase correlation between adjacent data pulses. Generation of the first coherent 160 Gb/s RZ signal allows us to demonstrate its sideband detection. The coherent 160 Gb/s RZ signal was detected with a record sensitivity of -26.45/spl plusmn/0.25 dBm.

articleTitle: Analytical model for the design of PSK based single channel and DWDM transmission systems
abstract: In This work an analytical model for the system design of DPSK and DQPSK based single channel and DWDM transmission systems is introduced and verified by the means of numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Stabilized liquid crystal rotatable fractional wave-plates stack for fast polarisation analysis and control

authors.preferredName: J.L. de Bougrenet de la Tocnaye

abstract: Design, fabrication and tests of fast rotating wave-plates based on nematic liquid crystals stabilized by a polymer matrix are reported. Appropriateness of performance to meet current specifications for PMD compensation in 40 Gb/s systems is addressed.

articleTitle: Loss-induced parametric amplification in optical fiber
abstract: We find both experimentally and theoretically that when the idler wave experiences large distributed loss relative to the signal wave, parametric gain arises in the normal dispersion regime of an optical fiber.

articleTitle: 60 km QKD transmission with polarization control, using 4+2 protocol with strong reference
abstract: We report a 60 km, polarization controlled, quantum key distribution scheme using single sideband (SSB) detection. Experiments were carried out at 1550 nm, over standard single-mode fiber spools and over a 44 km deployed LAN fiber.

articleTitle: 23 GHz injection-locked 1.55 /spl mu/m VCSEL
abstract: The resonance frequency of 1.55 /spl mu/m VCSEL is enhanced from the free-running 7 GHz to /spl sim/23 GHz with the optical injection technique. This is the highest value reported for VCSELs. This shows the scalability of speed improvement by injection locking. Furthermore, it illustrates a wider applicability to different laser designs.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked 25-GHz and 40-GHz Er:Yb:glass lasers
abstract: We demonstrate compact, passively fundamental-mode-locked Er:Yb:glass lasers with 25 GHz and 40 GHz repetition rate. They can serve as pulse generators for future high-speed RZ transmission systems or as multi-wavelength sources locked to the ITU grid.

articleTitle: Octave-spanning supercontinuum generation in an extruded PCF with an Er-doped fiber laser-amplifier system
abstract: We report on the generation of an ultrabroad supercontinuum spanning from 400 nm to over 1750 nm in an extruded SF6 PCF with only 200 pJ pulses from an all-fiber Er laser-amplifier system.

articleTitle: Precise time-resolved technique for a pump- and signal-induced phase shift measurement in fiber amplifiers
abstract: We have developed a precise (/spl sim/ /spl pi//25) and accurate time-resolved technique for measurement of pump-and signal induced phase shift in fiber amplifiers and demonstrated it with phase shift measurements in Nd-doped fiber amplifier.
