articleTitle: Experimental comparison of DPSK and OOK modulation formats over slope-matched fiber spans
abstract: The DPSK and OOK (on-off keying) modulation formats were compared experimentally over transoceanic distances with slope-matched fiber spans. Our results show a 2-3 dB DPSK benefit exists for a wide range of channel powers and transmission distances.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 42.7 Gb/s/spl times/32 WDM 4,300 km straight line transmission with commercially-applicable EDFA and DMF technologies
abstract: Commercial applicability of 42.7 Gb/s/spl times/32 WDM trans-oceanic system has been assured through 4,300 km straight-line transmission, with Q value performance higher than 10.2 dB, which is better than a detection limit of 8.8dB.

articleTitle: Study on optimum pre-filtering condition for 42.7 Gbit/s CS-RZ DPSK signal
abstract: The impact of asymmetric pre-filtering for 42.7 Gbit/s CS-RZ DPSK signals were investigated experimentally and numerically, including 9000 km WDM transmission experiments. We have found that asymmetric pre-filtering is effective for quasi-linear system applications.

articleTitle: OMNInet: a metropolitan 10 Gb/s DWDM photonic switched network trial
abstract: OMNInet is a long-term trial of an experimental DWDM photonically-switched network for data- and compute-intensive applications across a metropolitan area. The four-node field network includes scalable photonic nodes, protected wavelength-granularity mesh switching of 10 Gb/s Ethernet, a control plane, and photonic connection verification.

articleTitle: 160 Gb/s OTDM wavelength conversion using XPM in dispersion shifted fiber
abstract: Wavelength conversion of 160 Gb/s OTDM data using cross-phase modulation in 500 m of dispersion-shifted fiber is demonstrated for the first time. The converted channels can be received with a BER better than 10/sup -9/ and have a power penalty of <5 dB as compared to the 10 Gb/s baseline across all 16/spl times/10 Gbps channels.

articleTitle: Comparison of four multi-user quantum key distribution schemes over passive optical networks
abstract: The performance of multi-user quantum key distribution systems is compared for four different optical network topologies: Sagnac-based fiber ring, wavelength routed, passive star and bus. Their performances are analyzed using quantum bit error rate analysis.

articleTitle: Characteristics improvement of long-period fiber gratings fabricated by femtosecond laser pulses using novel positioning technique
abstract: A novel and precise positioning of focal point is developed to fabricate long-period fiber gratings by near-infrared femtosecond laser pulses. Low background loss of 0.26 dB, excellent transmission spectrum and highly controlled center wavelength are realized.

articleTitle: Spectral hole-burning in long-haul WDM transmission
abstract: Spectral hole burning in long-haul WDM transmission systems is reviewed, including: impact of different loading and aging conditions, modeling and experimental results obtained on installed systems, as well as measurements in broad band amplifiers.

articleTitle: Optical bistability and picosecond optical switching in bisbenzocyclobutene (BCB) polymer microring resonators
abstract: We demonstrate optical testability and all-optical switching in BCB polymer microring resonators. /spl Delta//spl lambda/ = 2 pm on- and off-switching response in frequency domain was achieved. With pumping by a pulsed laser, picosecond all-optical switching was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Sub glass transition relaxation in optical fibers
abstract: Investigations of the viscoelastic properties of silica-based optical fiber have revealed a fiber relaxation more than 700/spl deg/C below the glass transition temperature. The phenomenon is essentially dependent on the magnitude of the tension with which the fiber is drawn.

articleTitle: > 100 Gbit/s time-domain processing techniques optical packet switching
abstract: We present an architecture for an ultrafast all-optical packet switch based on OTDM packet processing techniques which have been demonstrated for synchronization, header processing, and packet forwarding at >100 Gbit/s line rates.

articleTitle: Optical gain at 1.5 /spl mu/m in nanocrystal Si sensitized, Er-doped silica waveguide using top-pumping 470 nm LED
abstract: We demonstrate optical gain at 1.5 /spl mu/m in Si nanocrystal-sensitized, Er-doped silica waveguide using a commercial, low-cost 470 nm LED in top-pumping configuration. Experimental evidence of full inversion with maximum possible gain of 3 dB/cm is presented.

articleTitle: A novel model of cross phase modulation in WDM optical systems
abstract: We propose a novel model for the evaluation of intensity and phase distortion due to XPM in WDM optical systems. The XPM effect is modeled as a perturbing term multiplying the undistorted signal.

articleTitle: Modeling and investigation of transient response in gain clamped Er-Yb and high concentration Er doped amplifier
abstract: To the best of our knowledge it is the first time that the gain-clamped Er-Yb doped amplifier dynamic response is modeled and investigated. Experiments confirm theoretical assumptions. Results also allow to describe dynamics in highly-doped erbium devices such as waveguide amplifiers.

articleTitle: Low loss, polarization insensitive SiON components
abstract: A low-loss (< 0.04 dB/cm, in the entire S-, C-, and L-bands), silicon-oxynitride (SiON) platform has been developed. Polarization insensitive directional couplers and compact, low loss (< 2 dB) AWGs with integrated spot-size converters have been fabricated.

articleTitle: Hybrid integration of active devices on PLC
abstract: Optoelectronic-integration technology using silica-based planar lightwave circuits is reported. Two types of integration configuration, surface mounted and facet mounted, are discussed. The application of these configurations to a bidirectional transceiver and multiwavelength receivers is described.

articleTitle: Positive-medial dispersion fiber of ring-core profile with attenuation as low as 0.210 dB/km and Aeff about 125 /spl mu/m/sup 2/
abstract: Attenuation of positive-medial dispersion fiber using a ring-core profile has been successfully decreased from 0.240 dB/km to 0.210 dB/km keeping large Aeff as 125 /spl mu/m/sup 2/. Attenuation of P-MDF using a conventional profile was also decreased as low as 0.180 dB/km.

articleTitle: Relative contributions to filter-induced Q penalty from eye closure and OSNR degradation
abstract: Experimental measurements are made of the relative contributions to optical filter-induced Q penalties from distortion (eye closure) and OSNR degradation. An expression relating Q penalty to simulated eye closure is derived and verified experimentally.

Index Terms: Optical Signal To Noise Ratio Degradation

articleTitle: Giga-symbol-per-second 16-QAM transmission over a single-channel Raman-amplified 100 km link
abstract: Results of the first demonstration of single-channel Gsymbol/s 16-QAM at a microwave frequency over a long dispersion-managed fiber link are presented. The link incorporates Raman amplification and achieved a high SNR and spurious-free dynamic range.

articleTitle: Complete characterization of various noise components in Raman amplifier using optical time domain reflectometry
abstract: We demonstrate a precise measurement of Rayleigh coefficient and its application for the complete experimental characterization of different noise components in the Raman amplifier under single experimental set-up, utilizing higher order Rayleigh scattering / signal trace measurement from the modified, high dynamic range OTDR.

articleTitle: Tunable dispersion compensation using phase modulation receiver part
abstract: A novel method of tuneable dispersion compensation at which phase modulation is applied in the receiver part is proposed for OTDM systems. Compensation of dispersion of 3.2 ps/nm at 160 Gb/s OTDM transmission is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhancement of spectral polarimetry for PMD measurement using transmitted signal spectra
abstract: By controlling the launch polarization into a calibrated, fixed differential group delay (DGD) element followed by a spectral polarimeter, we enhance the spectral polarimeter's ability to measure fiber DGD from signal spectra, thus enabling improved noninstrusive polarisation mode dispersion (PMD) monitoring.

articleTitle: Analysis of clipping distortion in an SCM lightwave transmitter with feed-forward correction
abstract: We analyze the performance of a feed-forward linearized transmitter in terms of clipping distortion. With electrical filtering it can produce an output RMS modulation depth of 28.0%, compared to 22.0% of a basic transmitter.

articleTitle: A planar waveguide single-detector
abstract: An integrated polarimeter using thermo-optic phase shifters, 4%-/spl Delta/ Ge-doped silica waveguides and requiring only a single detector is presented. Thermo-optic speeds up to 10 kHz are reported along with DOP and Stokes vector measurements.

articleTitle: Vertical-injection depleted optical thyristor laser diode for optical communication systems
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, the vertical-injection depleted optical thyristor laser diode (VIDOT-LD) with InGaAs/InGaAsP MQW structure. The output peak wavelength is at 1578 nm and the lasing threshold current is 131 mA.

articleTitle: Low-loss high-strength microstructured fiber fusion splices using GRIN fiber lenses
abstract: Gradient-index fiber lenses are used to fabricate high-strength (> 100 kpsi) fusion splices between microstructured optical fibers. High coupling efficiencies are attainable (< 0.6 dB loss), providing the mode field diameter is at least about 3.5 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Mixing of signals in two-pump fiber optic parametric amplifiers and wavelength converters
abstract: We measure four wave mixing tones generated by two signals within two pump fiber optical parametric amplifiers. Intensities of tones grow with length of fiber and signal power and show little dependence on signal separation.

articleTitle: A depressed-index cladding filter for suppressing 1.06 /spl mu/m emission in a Nd-doped silica fiber amplifier
abstract: A depressed-index cladding fiber is studied for wavelength filtering. The filter performance is measured with varying bend radii and twists. The filter is applied to a double-cladding Nd-fiber amplifier for suppression of 1.06 /spl mu/m emission.

articleTitle: Photonic WDM microwave filter with negative taps
abstract: A photonic microwave filter based on WDM technology with negative coefficients is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The scheme allows the synthesis of photonic microwave filters using conventional digital filter design procedures and using mass-market optical devices.

articleTitle: Dual-homing protection in WDM mesh networks
abstract: This work studies optical-layer protection design in a WDM mesh network given that, a dual-homing infrastructure is implemented at the IP layer. The problem is formulated as an integer linear program and solved using CPLEX.

articleTitle: Wavelength-routed optical network tolerance to inaccuracy in traffic load forecasts
abstract: We propose a novel method to quantify the tolerance of wavelength-routed network designs to inaccuracies in traffic load forecasts. We demonstrate its use through simulations investigating features of topology and wavelength conversion affecting network tolerance.

articleTitle: Polarization dependent wavelength shift and new polarization modulation locking for phase-shifted fiber Bragg gratings
abstract: We present polarization sensitive characterization of fiber Bragg gratings and a novel wavelength reference based on a laser stabilized to a grating. The locking scheme enables a relative wavelength accuracy better 10/sup -7 /(0.15 pm) at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Polarization dependent gain simulation in dual-order Raman fiber amplifiers
abstract: We model the effect of the degree of polarization of the pumps on the signal polarization dependent gain (PDG) in dual-order Raman amplifiers. The primary source of PDG is found to be the first-order pump.

articleTitle: All-fiber chirped pulse amplification with recompression in an air-core photonic bandgap fiber
abstract: We show all-fiber chirped pulse amplification using an air-core photonic bandgap fiber for recompression. 400 fs pulses at 1.55 /spl mu/m were stretched to several tens of picoseconds in a dispersion compensating fiber and recompressed down to /spl sim/1 ps.

articleTitle: 1.36 Tbit/s spectral slicing source based on a Cr/sup 4+/:YAG femtosecond laser
abstract: We report a novel OTDM/WDM source based on spectral slicing of a passively mode-locked Cr/sup 4+/:YAG femtosecond pulse source. Total capacities up to 682 Gbit/s and 1.36 Tbit/s with spectral efficiencies of 0.2 b/s/Hz and 0.4b/s/Hz have been achieved.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable wavelength-routed network with N/spl times/N AWG arranged in CWDM bands for bandwidth on demand
abstract: We propose a DWDM wavelength-routed network with an N/spl times/N AWG that forms reconfigurable connections or static connections arranged in CWDM bands. We demonstrate the function of bandwidth control for traffic demand using this network.

articleTitle: Low phase noise photonic millimeter-wave generation by using a reciprocating optical modulator
abstract: We demonstrated low phase noise millimeter-wave generation by using an reciprocating optical modulator. A lightwave modulated by 44 GHz millimeter-waves was obtained from a microwave signal, with low phase noise of -88.5 dBc/Hz at 10 kHz offset.

articleTitle: "New architectures and applications for integrated packet and optical routing equipment in metro area networks"
abstract: In a scenario of growing broadband services, an innovative Metro Network Architecture with distributed IP/MPLS processing capabilities integrated with flexible DWDM systems provides great advantages for cost savings, flexibility and scalability to Established Service Providers.

articleTitle: Selection-free WDM DFB lasers for high power applications
abstract: A selection-free DFB structure is proposed for the fabrication of high power CW single mode lasers. The spectral uniformity is experimentally demonstrated on 2" wafer for tapered-DFB lasers having a maximum output power higher than 85 mW at 25/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: A new design approach for DFB lasers for improved
abstract: New design approach for DFB lasers based on increasing effective cavity length is described. Method experimentally verified in Er/Yb codoped fibre and 37% increase in the efficiency achieved.

articleTitle: Novel layer peeling algorithm for the synthesis of fiber Bragg gratings yielding smoother fabrication profiles
abstract: We propose a new layer peeling method for the synthesis of FBG devices based on the reconstruction of the FBG by means of a series of layers with constant refractive indexes instead of using a series of distributed feedback reflectors. Smoother fabrication profiles are obtained.

articleTitle: High quality 1.3 ps 10 GHz soliton pulse source employing dispersion decreasing fiber based Raman amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate a novel pulse compression scheme using DDF adiabatic compression process assisted by distributed Raman gain. Both wavelength tunability of about 30 nm and pulse-duration tunability from 1 to 5 ps are also demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-speed optical frequency modulation in a monolithically integrated widely-tunable laser-phase modulator
abstract: A factor of ten improvement of modulation bandwidth, from 2 GHz to 20 GHz, is demonstrated using phase modulator monolithically integrated to a semiconductor amplifier and a widely-tunable SG-DBR (sampled-grating distributed Bragg reflector) laser. This is achieved by generating optical frequency modulation converted to intensity modulation in an optical ASE filter.

articleTitle: Hybrid radio over fiber wireless LANs and Ethernet networks
abstract: A hybrid wireless local area network over fiber and Ethernet are evaluated for its transmission over multimode fiber. The one gigabit Ethernet can coexist with the five gigahertz wireless network.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 16/spl times/10 Gb/s WDM transmission over 4/spl times/40 km of SMF using linear optical amplifiers combined with Raman-pumped dispersion compensation fibers under dynamic add/drop situations
abstract: 16/spl times/10 Gb/s WDM signals were successfully transmitted over 4/spl times/40 km of SMF using LOAs combined with dispersion compensating RFAs. No add/drop-induced penalty was observed when 15 channels out of 16 channels were dynamically add/dropped.

articleTitle: An integrated IP/optical approach for efficient access router failure recovery
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel IP/optical integrated architecture to cost effectively recover from access router failures in large ISP networks.

articleTitle: An optical packet routing loop mitigation scheme using periodically phase-modulated time-to-live (TTL) field
abstract: We propose a novel optical packet time-to-live (TTL) processing scheme using periodically phase-modulated TTL fields. Asynchronous packet TTL countdown and eventual dropping of expired packet using this scheme was experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Data rate and channel spacing flexible wavelength blocking filter
abstract: We present a high-resolution blocking filter, which seamlessly supports data rates from 2.5 Gbit/s to 160 Gbit/s with a granularity of 13.2 GHz. The filter consists of a linear array of 64 MEMS micromirrors and a high-dispersion echelle grating.

articleTitle: Experimental measurements of spin period in randomly-birefringent spun fibers
abstract: We present a POTDR-based technique to measure the spin period of randomly-birefringent spun fibers. Experimental results are in excellent agreement with the nominal spin periods of ad hoc drawn fibers.

articleTitle: Statistics of nonlinear phase noise in phase modulated fiber-optic communications systems
abstract: We derive a method for evaluating the distribution of the phase noise in phase and differential phase modulated systems. The method considers both SPM and XPM induced phase noise and accounts for fiber dispersion. The noise distribution can be used to estimate arbitrarily small bit-error rates for PSK and DPSK systems. The theoretical analysis agrees with Monte Carlo simulations of WDM systems.

articleTitle: Modeling the distributed gain of single (1050 nm or 1400 nm) and dual-wavelength (800 nm + 1050 nm or 800 nm + 1410 nm) pumped TDFAs
abstract: We have modeled the distributed gain of single and dual-wavelength pumped TDFAs. Comparing with COFDR measurements, the excellent agreement of the model enabled us to estimate branching ratios and cross-sections of the thulium-doped fiber.

articleTitle: Normally-off liquid crystal VOA achieves temperature invariant attenuation through passive thermal compensation
abstract: Through the orthogonal alignment of an additional passive LC cell, identical to the first, into a normally-on LC VOA, a normally-off VOA with temperature insensitive attenuation was achieved by means of passive thermal compensation.

articleTitle: Polymer long-period waveguide gratings
abstract: We report long-period gratings fabricated in various polymer waveguide structures by using the UV-irradiation and the etching techniques. These gratings can be tuned thermally over a wide wavelength range. Achievement of polarization insensitivity is highlighted.

articleTitle: High speed liquid crystal devices for polarization control and analysis
abstract: High-speed liquid-crystal waveplates fabricated between tips of optical fibers show excellent performance when implemented for DOP measurements and PMD compensation in 40 Gb/s system. Results indicate that these devices have potential application in optical communication systems.

articleTitle: Monitoring of the fiber Bragg grating fabrication process
abstract: We report first experimental results on real-time monitoring of the complex coupling coefficient along fiber Bragg grating under fabrication based on its simple relationship with the grating complex reflection coefficient measured at a single wavelength.

articleTitle: 40 Gbit/s single-drive thin sheet X-cut LiNbO/sub 3/ optical modulator with low driving-voltage of 2 V
abstract: We developed a 40 Gb/s single-drive X-cut LiNbO/sub 3/ optical modulator with a driving-voltage of 2V. This modulator employs a novel thin-sheet LiNbO/sub 3/ structure, and has high potential for suppressed dc-drift, zero-chirp, and long-term reliability.

articleTitle: Waveguide optical isolator integratable to LDs and SOAs
abstract: The wafer bonding of magneto-optic garnet with III/V compound semiconductors was developed for integrating an optical isolator with semiconductor optical devices. The preliminary experiment is demonstrated in an interferometric isolator having a semiconductor guiding layer.

articleTitle: Manufacture of perfluorinated plastic optical fibers
abstract: We review manufacturing processes for graded-index polymer optical fiber (GI-POF). We also demonstrate a new extrusion process, which produces GI-POF at much lower cost, with attenuation below 25 dB/km, and bandwidth greater than 400 MHz-km.

articleTitle: A complete internal mechanical stress analysis of multilayer composite leads to optimized coating process control for 50 GHz thin film filters
abstract: Internal stress simulation of a multilayer structure using measured wafer curvature accurately predicts the central wavelength shifts and spectrum ripple resulting from grinding and temperature change, thereby greatly improving the production yield of 50 GHz filters.

articleTitle: System impact of pump phase modulation for fiber optical parametric amplifiers
abstract: BERs induced by a parametric amplifier with a 10 Gbit/s line rate have been measured. It is shown numerically and experimentally that a PRBS phase modulation of the pump distorts the mark level of the channel and may cause system penalty.

articleTitle: Manufacture of high-performance fiber Bragg for dispersion compensation
abstract: Significant progress has been achieved in the manufacture of chirped fiber Bragg gratings for dispersion compensation. Iterative correction technique further improves their quality and enables consistent fabrication of gratings with unprecedented performance.

articleTitle: Effect of grating imperfections on devices based on tilted fiber gratings
abstract: Cross-sectional and longitudinal defects in tilted fiber gratings are studied, and their influence on grating devices is discussed. Fiber gratings with various imperfections are fabricated; their scattering patterns are measured and compared to simulation results.

articleTitle: Directly modulated CWDM/DWDM system using negative dispersion fiber for metro network application
abstract: We demonstrate the error-free transmission of directly modulated 2.5-Gb/s, 10-Gb/s, and 40-Gb/s CWDM/DWDM signals over negative dispersion fiber (dispersion: -2.5 ps/km/nm @1550 nm) without dispersion compensation. The results indicate that the metro core/access network could be implemented cost-effectively by using the negative dispersion fiber and directly modulated lasers.

articleTitle: Effects of phase errors and shot noise on asynchronous coherent optical CDMA
abstract: Effects of phase errors and shot noise on asynchronous coherent optical code division multiple access systems are examined here. It is shown that asynchronous systems have better bit error performance than the synchronous systems.

articleTitle: Impact of double Rayleigh scattering noise in time division multiplexed Raman pumping schemes
abstract: The impact of double-Rayleigh scattering noise in time-division-multiplexed counter-propagating Raman pumping schemes is theoretically and experimentally investigated. High pump modulation frequencies effectively reduce DRS noise enhancement which is induced, especially at low duty-cycles, by TDM-pumping.

articleTitle: Fully-reconfigurable wavelength-selective optical 1 /spl times/ N switch based on transversal filter configuration
abstract: A novel wavelength-selective switch is proposed and demonstrated. The switch has a 1 /spl times/ 4 transversal filter configuration that includes AWGs and thermo-optic phase shifters, and can route input light at an arbitrary wavelength to arbitrary outputs with no loss variation. We confirmed its operating principle and obtained an average loss of 5.7 dB and an average extinction ratio of 27 dB.

articleTitle: New techniques for high-speed optical characterization
abstract: Recent advances in high-speed optical characterization are reviewed. Diagnostics with high temporal resolution, high sensitivity or phase sensitivity are now available for the development of high-speed optical communications.

articleTitle: Measurement of differential group delay in a recirculating loop
abstract: We show for the first time the measurement of DGD in a recirculating loop for specific fiber realizations. With this capability we measure DGD distribution in the loop with and without scrambling.

articleTitle: S-band optical amplification employing silica-based phosphorous/alumina-codoped EDF
abstract: Employing silica-based P/Al-codoped EDF, the gain enhancement of 9 dB compared to Al-codoped EDF has been achieved over the wavelength range from 1491 to 1502 nm in the four-stage configuration EDFA pumped with the power of 400 mW.

articleTitle: Raman-effect induced noise-figure limit for /spl chi//sup (3)/ parametric amplifiers and wavelength converters
abstract: The non-zero response time of the Kerr nonlinearity sets a fundamental limit on the noise figure of phase-insensitive fiber parametric amplifiers and wavelength converters. Our theory shows good agreement with experiments.

articleTitle: Single step writing of equalised bandwidth Bragg gratings within planar light-wave circuits
abstract: We demonstrate single-step writing of waveguide circuits with Bragg gratings between 1227 nm and 1687 nm and for the first time show that the grating bandwidth can be normalised over this large wavelength range.

articleTitle: 120/spl deg/C uncooled operation of direct modulated 1.3/spl mu/m AlGaInAs-MQW DFB laser diodes for 10Gb/s telecom applications
abstract: 1.3 /spl mu/m AlGaInAs-MQW DFB laser diodes were fabricated for 10 Gb/s uncooled light sources. Applying an n-InGaAsP/n-InP buried grating, output power of 5 mW at 120/spl deg/C and clear eye opening at 105/spl deg/C for OC-192 mask was obtained.

articleTitle: PMD-limited transmission with CS-RZ and NRZ in joint field trial: 43-Gbit/s NTT's transport system in DT's installed fiber environment
abstract: 43-Gbit/s PMD-limited performances of CS-RZ and NRZ have been verified in a joint field trail. CS-RZ showed better performance than NRZ. 2/sup nd/-order PMD of 200 ps/sup 2/ was accommodated in principal state of polarization transmission with FEC.

articleTitle: Inverse multiplexing in optical transport networks with the support of SONET/SDH virtual concatenation
abstract: Emerging SONET/SDH techniques enable a high-bandwidth connection to be carried by multiple diversely-routed, low-speed connections. We investigate the benefits of such an inverse-multiplexing mechanism in optical networks and propose several efficient diverse-routing algorithms.

articleTitle: High-speed optical FSK modulator for optical packet labeling
abstract: We demonstrate 10 Gbps FSK transmission, and simultaneous modulation by FSK and IM using a newly developed high-speed FSK modulator. We also proposed a novel optical label swapping technique having no pumping light sources.

articleTitle: All optical reshaping in 160 Gbit/s OTDM receiver using an XAM gate followed by an SPM discriminator
abstract: We demonstrated all optical reshaping in 160 Gbit/s OTDM receiver utilizing cross-absorption modulation gate followed by self-phase modulation-based pulse-level discriminator. We simultaneously achieved improved extinction ratio and error-free demultiplexing for all sixteen tributary channels.

articleTitle: Impact of spectral hole burning in multichannel amplification of EDFA
abstract: We model the gain variation due to the signal allocation change in multichannel EDFA amplification by introducing the effect of spectral hole burning (SHE). Our numerical model, describing the behavior of both positive and negative gain variation near to 1530 nm, gives good results in agreement with the measure results.

articleTitle: Potential of nanoparticle technologies for next generation erbium-doped fibers
abstract: Nanoparticle technologies improve the doping processes. This results superior uniformity, higher erbium concentration and better control of refractive index profile. The nanoparticle technology will improve the economics and the quality of the erbium doped fiber.

articleTitle: Wavelength division demultiplexer using polymer optical waveguide and diffraction grating
abstract: We have studied a new wavelength division demultiplexer for coarse wavelength division multiplexing. A polymer optical waveguide and a diffraction grating were applied to facilitate assembly and miniaturization. The prototype demultiplexer demonstrated fairly satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: Low-cost coolerless 10Gb/s integrated laser-modulator
abstract: For short and medium reach network applications, we propose a low-cost and high performance integrated laser-electroabsorption modulator source. We demonstrate coolerless and isolator-free 10 Gb/s transmission over 25 km, for temperature ranging from 10 to 80/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Reach extension in 10 Gb/s long-haul fiber links with adaptive eye mapping in a Si-CMOS 16-bit transceiver IC
abstract: We demonstrate system performance improvement by adaptive eye mapping of a 10 Gb/s Si-CMOS 16-bit transceiver IC. Doubling the reach from 1000-km to 2000-km has been achieved by adaptively adjusting the threshold/phase over conventional receiver.

articleTitle: Fiber connector inspection system
abstract: This work proposes some effective methods to compensate the unevenly distributed illumination problem so that standard image processing methods can efficiently be used to detect the defects of the fiber connectors.

articleTitle: Optical fibre networks and systems in India
abstract: We provide an overview of optical fibre networks in India. Most service providers have deployed an SDH STM-16, or a modest DWDM backbone. Next-generation SDH equipment with Ethernet capability is being used for data services.

articleTitle: Interference suppression in a hybrid OCDMA/WDMA system
abstract: A hybrid OCDMA/WDMA system is further investigated. We rebuild the liquid crystal modulator (LCM) which serves as the encoder/decoder of the OCDMA system. Lower probability of error is obtained and better performance can be achieved.

articleTitle: Q-factor monitoring for fault management applications
abstract: We show that a sensitivity of 0.5 dB is required for using Q-factor to monitor noise for fault localization and analyze monitoring without dispersion compensation in 10 Gb/s networks with symmetric dispersion maps.

articleTitle: Bit-level switching in a fiber parametric processor with inherent wavelength conversion and optical conjugation
abstract: Multiple-band switching in two-pump fiber device is demonstrated. The architecture combines band amplification, wavelength conversion and selective conjugation. Bit-level switching is demonstrated over a bandwidth greater than 50 nm, with maximal conversion efficiency of 24.2-dB.

articleTitle: Fourier-transform spectrometer based on a tilted superstructure fiber grating
abstract: We demonstrate a novel spectrometer that operates by measuring the near-field interference pattern produced by a tilted superstructure fiber grating. Grating design parameters allow flexible optimization of the spectrometer's bandwidth and resolution.

articleTitle: Alternative amplifiers
abstract: Changing requirements in optical networking have spurred the development of alternative amplifiers. Such amplifiers target applications not addressed by erbium-doped amplifiers. This paper will review alternative amplifiers in relation to applications in optical networks.

articleTitle: Simple and robust all-optical label switching based on the 2nd harmonic subcarrier multiplexing technique
abstract: We report the experimental results of a novel 2nd harmonic subcarrier multiplexed (SCM) signal generation and detection scheme, which is robust to the wavelength drift of an optical filter and the transmitter.

articleTitle: High-speed and high-efficiency InP/InGaAs waveguide avalanche photodiodes for 40 Gbit/s transmission systems
abstract: InP/InGaAs waveguide avalanche photodiodes for 40 Gbit/s are demonstrated for the first time. The highest sensitivity of -19.0 dBm is achieved at BER of 10/sup -12/ in 40 Gbit/s PRBS 2/sup 31/- 1 NRZ signal.

articleTitle: Isolator-free, uncooled operation of highly strained 1.1 /spl mu/m GalnAs/GaAs vertical cavity surface emitting laser for 10 Gb/s single mode fiber data transmission
abstract: We demonstrate 10 Gb/s single mode fiber data transmission using an uncooled 1.12 /spl mu/m GalnAs/GaAs QW VCSEL with optical feedback. Isolator-free operation with -24 dB optical feedback is successfully demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Transmission of 32/spl times/43 Gb/s over 27/spl times/100 km of TeraLight fiber low-cost EDFA amplification
abstract: We transmit 32 channels at 43 Gb/s over 2730 km using only single-stage EDFA line amplifiers and an original system configuration, with dispersion-compensating higher-order fiber modules at the beginning of the span.

articleTitle: Bending-induced thermal stress birefringence in single-mode fibers
abstract: The field deformation in bent fibers causes a non-symmetric field overlap with the thermal fiber stress profile and yields large modal stress birefringence. The latter can fully compensate the well-known bending-induced mechanical stress birefringence.

articleTitle: New single polarization fiber with high extinction ratio
abstract: A new hole-assisted single polarization fiber is fabricated with extinction ratios as high as 60 dB in lengths smaller than 1 meter. The fiber contains a hole on each side of the core and on the minor axis.

articleTitle: A liquid crystal based Fourier optical spectrum
abstract: We propose a liquid crystal based Fourier optical spectrum analyzer without moving parts. It can retrieve and recover the envelope of the DWDM spectrum to act as a channel power monitor in fiber-optic communication systems.

articleTitle: Optical networking evolution in ITU-T and IETF-a reality check
abstract: Standards for optical control plane technologies are currently under development. There are four standards bodies working in this area: ITU-T, T1X1, IETF and OIF. Both the IETF and ITU-T are starting to work in the following areas: multidomain optical control plane architecture and protocols, protection and restoration architecture and protocols, GMPLS signaling and routing portfolio extensions to support ITU-T generic control plane architectures.

articleTitle: Simplified inverse Fourier transform technique to determine second-order optical nonlinearity profiles using a reference sample
abstract: A new technique to uniquely determine the nonlinearity profile of nonlinear thin films using a known reference sample is demonstrated. This method is simpler, faster, and experimentally easier to implement than earlier techniques.

articleTitle: Polarization-independent tunable bandpass filter in Ti:LiNbO/sub 3/ utilizing symmetric branch beam splitters
abstract: A novel two-port polarization-independent electro-optically tunable bandpass filter in the 1550 nm wavelength regime with a tuning range of 13 nm and a tuning rate of 0.082 nm/V is reported.

articleTitle: High speed and high responsivity UTC photodiode module for > 40 Gb/s optical receivers
abstract: UTC photodiode module with responsivity of 0.72 A/W (TE/TM = 0.4 dB) and bandwidth > 50 GHz is demonstrated. 517 mV output voltage (+12 dBm optical power) and 1.38 ps jitter are achieved at 40 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Mitigation of nonlinear impairments from semiconductor optical amplifiers using an optical equalizer
abstract: We demonstrate and study significant improvements in the measured bit-error rates of 40-Gb/s signals distorted after passing through a single and a cascade of two semiconductor optical amplifiers by using a simple colorless optical equalizer.

articleTitle: First demonstration of air-silica Bragg fiber
abstract: We present experimental and theoretical results on air-silica Bragg fibers. The TE/sub 01/ mode is observed for the first time to our knowledge in Bragg fibers. We could transmit light by bandgap guiding over 50 m.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated balanced photoreceiver OEIC comprising a distributed amplifier for 40 Gbit/s applications
abstract: A novel balanced photoreceiver with integrated amplifier, based on InP, is presented. The device exhibits an overall conversion gain of 35 V/W, low output reflection and well opened synthesized eye pattern at 40 Gbit/s NRZ modulation format.

articleTitle: Deployment of 40 Gb/s systems: technical and cost issues
abstract: First we discuss market opportunities for 40 Gb/s systems. Next we discuss practical requirements that 40 Gb/s systems must meet to become commercially deployed. Finally, we discuss the trade-off between the achievable transmission distance and the complexity/cost of transponders and line systems.

articleTitle: Hybrid edge IP/optical packet generator in wavelength routed networks
abstract: This paper presents a class-based optical packet assembly mechanism and hardware architecture for hybrid edge IP-optical packet generator. Simulation and demonstration results show that it is well suited for mapping IP into optical packet traffic.

articleTitle: Self-pulsating DFB for 40 GHz clock-recovery: impact of intensity fluctuations on jitter
abstract: We analyze the impact of intensity fluctuations on the jitter of a 40 GHz self-pulsating laser. A jitter reduction from 1.7 ps to 600 fs due to intensity-noise suppression is demonstrated for locking to 40 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion measurement error caused by source amplified spontaneous emission
abstract: We demonstrate the degrading effect of noise from amplified spontaneous emission on measurements of chromatic dispersion using the modulation phase-shift method. Dramatic performance improvement is achieved with a narrow-band tracking filter.

articleTitle: Innovations in BER testers enable fast and accurate eye diagram, eye mask, Q-factor, and jitter measurements
abstract: Successful integration of fast and accurate eye diagram, eye mask, jitter, and Q-factor functions into a BER tester has been demonstrated. These measurements can be done with far greater speed and statistical accuracy than previously possible.

articleTitle: High-speed programmable true-time-delay optical beamformer based on recirculating loop
abstract: A cost effective and programmable true-time-delay (TTD) optical beamformer based on recirculating loop is proposed. The steering speed can reach up to nanoseconds. The experiment has been done to prove the method.

articleTitle: Regular and irregular low-density parity-check codes for ultra-long haul high-speed optical communications: construction and performance analysis
abstract: We propose a novel FEC scheme based on regular/ irregular low-density parity-check codes that significantly outperform all previously reported FEC schemes (RS and turbo codes). High code-rate, large minimum distances and simple decoding algorithms of the proposed codes allow very high-speed implementations.

articleTitle: Field trial of GMPLS-based 40-Gbit/s wavelength protection by photonic crossconnect with chromatic dispersion compensation
abstract: We have succeeded field trial of GMPLS-based 40-Gbit/s wavelength path protection by photonic crossconnect. An automatic chromatic dispersion compensator was successfully applied to maintain the quality of a signal after protection operation.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of the effect of polarization scrambling speed on the performance of PMD mitigation using FEC
abstract: Evaluation of the effect of polarization scrambling speed on PMD mitigation using FEC was carried out experimentally. It was found that the polarization scrambling speed could severely affect the performance of FEC.

articleTitle: A tunable ultra-narrowband filter for subcarrier processing and optical monitoring
abstract: A tunable filter with power complementary outputs and optimal isolation is presented that operates on multiple tones. A triple-peak filter with sub-GHz bandwidth and over 25 dB isolation was realized with sub-milliwatt thermo-optic switching power.

articleTitle: Integrated circuits on-PLC integration
abstract: We review two IC-on-PLC integration technologies. One is the integration of 10 Gbit/s driver ICs for compact optical transmitters/receivers. The other is that of multichannel ICs for large-scale PLC switches, which reduces the module size by 3/4.

articleTitle: Regenerative all-optical wavelength converter based on semiconductor optical amplifier and sharp frequency response filter
abstract: We propose a new architecture for regenerative all optical wavelength conversion. The conversion utilizes the induced chirp in SOA amplifier and sharp frequency response filter. 20,000 km transmission and cascadability are demonstrated in recirculating loop experiment.

articleTitle: Wide-locking-range 160-GHz optical clock recovery from 160-Gbit/s signal using a mode-locked laser diode
abstract: A 160-GHz optical clock is recovered from a 160-Gbit/s signal using a mode-locked laser diode in a wide wavelength range. The locking range is over 700 MHz due to the integrated chirped distributed Bragg reflector.

articleTitle: A wide-beam propagating fiber for embedding bulky optical devices
abstract: We report a compact, low-loss, and robust fiber collimator making use of a specific graded index fiber in which a wide Gaussian beam propagates. The fiber simplifies fabrication and alignment of collimators.

articleTitle: PMD outage measurements in a joint field trial of a 43-Gbit/s NTT WDM transmission system within DT's installed fiber environment
abstract: PMD induced system outage probabilities have been measured in a joint field trial of NTT and DT. For outage evaluation 43-Gbit/s CS-RZ signals of the NTT WDM system were transmitted over selected high-PMD fiber links of DT's fiber network.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of variable-size packet contention resolution and switching in an optical-label switching router
abstract: This paper discusses experimental demonstrations of variable-size optical packet switching with optical contention resolution, utilizing a packet length field in the optical label. The experiment achieves error-free operation and negative power penalty.

articleTitle: Continuous wave fiber parametric amplifier with 41.5 nm of flat gain
abstract: Record performance of parametric fiber amplifier is reported. Continuous-wave optical gain was measured over 41.5 nm. Equalized gain was achieved in two-pump architecture without gain flattening elements. Maximal operating bandwidth was limited by fiber dispersion fluctuations.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion and SPM tolerance of 8-state/symbol (binary ASK and QPSK) modulated signal
abstract: We experimentally evaluate the tolerance of 8-state/symbol optical modulation (binary ASK and QPSK) to chromatic dispersion and SPM, and investigate the cause of sensitivity degradation induced by simultaneous modulation of amplitude and phase.

articleTitle: Raman gain enhanced FWM 160 Gb/s OTDM demultiplexer with highly-nonlinear-fiber
abstract: Error free demultiplexing of 160 Gbps data to 10 Gbps was demonstrated with less than 2 dB power penalty using Raman gain enhanced four-wave-mixing in highly-nonlinear-fiber. A 19 dB efficiency increase over FWM without Raman was achieved by using 400 mW of Raman pump power.

articleTitle: Multiple failure restoration in mesh optical networks
abstract: We consider resilient design for stressed optical networks. We compare existing commercial architectures with alternative architectures in both the low and high stress regimes.

articleTitle: A load-balancing shared-protection-path reconfiguration approach in WDM wavelength-routed networks
abstract: We propose a load-balancing shared-protection-path reconfiguration approach for WDM wavelength-routed networks, using which service providers can re-optimize the network utilization to postpone network upgrades, resulting in significant cost savings.

articleTitle: Availability-guaranteed service provisioning with shared-path protection in optical WDM networks
abstract: We develop an availability model to capture network failure characteristics and resource information for each link. Based on this link-state model, we propose an availability-guaranteed-connection-provisioning algorithm which significantly improves connection reliability and uses resource efficiently.

articleTitle: Ultra low PMD fibers by fiber spinning
abstract: This paper reviews fiber spinning technology for making low PMD fibers. Theoretical understanding of fiber spinning mechanism and features of spun fibers, as well as applications in fiber spin profile designs are discussed.

articleTitle: Optical label detection and packet switching using a 4/spl times/4 optical crosspoint switch matrix
abstract: 155 Mb/s WDM label channel is detected directly by switch cells in a 4/spl times/4 optical crosspoint switch matrix without added optical components. Switching performance of 10 Gb/s packets is not affected by the detection process.

articleTitle: Low dispersion penalty at 10 Gb/s, over 75 km, using a quantum-well-intermixed electroabsorption-modulator/widely-tunable laser transmitter
abstract: 10 Gb/s low power penalty (<0.5 dB) error-free transmission was achieved through 75 km using a high-performance widely-tunable EAM/laser transmitter operating under negative chirp conditions. An integration-oriented quantum-well-intermixing process was employed for the realization of these devices.

articleTitle: A gigahertz silicon-on-insulator Mach-Zehnder modulator
abstract: We report a modulator in which a polysilicon-oxide-silicon capacitor forms a ridge waveguide to achieve unprecedented performance in silicon: 2.5 GHz small-signal bandwidth and a driver-limited extinction ratio of 5 dB at 1 gigabit per second.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of non linear threshold and optimum pre dispersion of 43 Gb/s ASK and DPSK formats
abstract: 43 Gb/s ASK and DPSK formats, each with 4 duty-cycles, are compared on single channel nonlinear impairments. We measured the nonlinear threshold, pre-dispersion optimum and tolerance and found a NLT benefit for DPSK up to 2 dB.

articleTitle: Investigation of SOA nonlinearities on the amplification of high spectral efficiency signals
abstract: We investigated and compared the effect of SOA nonlinearities on 12.5 Gsymbol/s RZ-OOK, RZ-DQPSK, and polarization-bit-interleaved RZ-DQPSK DWDM channels with 20-GHz spacing. Our results showed that polarization-bit-interleaved RZ-DQPSK is overall most tolerant to SOA nonlinearities.

articleTitle: Record high mask margin in uncooled directly-modulated laser-diode modules with a driver IC for 10.7 Gbit/s SONET applications
abstract: Uncooled directly-modulated laser-diode modules with a driver IC were successfully demonstrated with a record-high mask margin of 15% under 10.7 Gbit/s (22% under 9.95 Gbit/s) even at 85/spl deg/C and an extinction ratio of 7.5 dB.

articleTitle: Reduction in optical loss of conventional and photonic crystal fibers
abstract: We reevaluate the intrinsic losses of silica-based optical fibers at 0.095 - 0.130 dB/km at 1.55 /spl mu/m, and describe the impact of loss reduction in conventional and photonic crystal fibers on wavelength-division-multiplexing transmission systems.

articleTitle: Compactly integrated 32-channel AWG multiplexer with variable optical attenuators and power monitors based on multichip PLC technique
abstract: A 32-channel AWG multiplexer equipped with VOAs, power-tap monitors and an athermal AWG is developed based on the multichip PLC technique. Compactly integrated modules without patching fibers and a low VOA power are successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of long-haul transport at 42.7-Gb/s through concatenated optical add/drop nodes
abstract: We compare the single-channel transmission performance of 5 different modulation formats (NRZ, RZ, CSRZ, RZ-DPSK and CSRZ-DPSK) over a long haul network with optical add/drop multiplexers at varying node spacing.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s duobinary receiver with a record sensitivity of 88 photons per bit
abstract: We demonstrate a novel receiver concept for duobinary signals that allows for data recovery with a sensitivity of -39.5 dBm (88 Photons/bit, BER=1.10/sup -9/, 2/sup 31/ -1 PRBS). Oversampling together with maximum likelihood sampling phase estimation results in superior back-to-back performance without lowering the large chromatic dispersion tolerance of duobinary signaling.

articleTitle: Localized failure restoration in mesh optical networks
abstract: A novel localized restoration architecture is presented that combines the speed of line-based protection with the capacity efficiency of path-based restoration, and enables recovery from link and node failures while bypassing fault isolation.

articleTitle: All-optical OOK label swapping on OFSK payload in optical packet networks
abstract: We propose to superimpose OOK label onto high-speed OFSK payload in optical packet networks. The transmission performance of 1.244-Gb/s label on 9.953-Gb/s payload was investigated and all-optical label swapping was successfully demonstrated with low penalty.

articleTitle: Towards a meshed ultra high speed TDM optical network concept, OADM architecture and proof of principle
abstract: Meshed ultra-high-speed OTDM networks give rise to a couple of challenges concerning the architecture of network elements. We present an architecture of an OTDM-ADM and its experimental proof of concept.

articleTitle: Advanced MEMS devices for channelized dispersion compensation
abstract: The application of grating based optical systems with MEMS variable phase elements to channelized dispersion compensation will be discussed.

articleTitle: 40 Gbit/s, multihop optical packet routing using optical label processing based packet switch prototype
abstract: 40 Gbit/s, three-hop optical packet routing using optical code label processing based packet switch nodes is experimentally demonstrated. 200 Gchip/s all-optical label processing, optical switching, optical buffering, electronic scheduling, and optical packet merge are achieved.

articleTitle: Low-loss and flat/wide-passband CWDM demultiplexer using silica-based AWG with multi-mode output waveguides
abstract: We demonstrated compact and cost-effective 8-channel filters for unidirectional and bidirectional CWDM systems with a low loss of 1.7 dB, a wide 1-dB bandwidth of 14 run, and low crosstalk by using an AWG with multi-mode waveguides.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion monitoring using partial optical filtering and phase-shift detection of bit rate and doubled half bit rate frequency components
abstract: We demonstrate dispersion monitoring technique by comparing the phase of RF components at the bit rate and the doubled half-bit-rate after partial-optical-filtering. This technique enhances the monitoring range by four times compared to conventional phase-shift-detection techniques.

articleTitle: Superimposed ASK label in a 10 Gbps multi-hop all-optical label swapping system
abstract: This work proposes a novel optical label swapping technique in which a low-speed ASK label is superimposed on top of a high-speed DC-balanced-line-coded ASK payload. The technique is demonstrated via a 10 Gbps multi-hop transmission experiment.

articleTitle: Novel technique for polarization independent all-optical sampling in fiber
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple single-path technique for polarization independent all-optical sampling in fiber. The residual polarization dependence was only 0.3 dB and no polarization dependent waveform distortion was detected.

articleTitle: Field test of GMPLS all-optical path rerouting
abstract: Router-to-router all-optical wavelength path rerouting using generalized multiprotocol label switching protocols has been successfully carried out including photonic cross-connect and dense wavelength-division multiplexing equipment. The rerouting time was measured to be shorter than seven seconds.

articleTitle: 3D time-wavelength-polarization OCDMA coding for increasing the number of users in OCDMA LANs
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a three-dimensional optical code-division-multiple-access (OCDMA) system that encodes user data in time, wavelength, and polarization. Our sample codeset can support >2x the users of a 2D codeset with /spl sim/1.8 dB power penalty.

articleTitle: Cascade of all-optical wavelength conversion for RZ-DPSK format using four wave mixing in SOA
abstract: We have demonstrated 10 stages cascaded wavelength conversion over 800 km transmission for 10 Gb/s RZ-DPSK format using FWM in SOA. The performance of wavelength conversion for RZ-DPSK format is much better than that for OOK format.

articleTitle: Integrated electro-absorption modulation DFB laser based all-optical subcarrier label swapping
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an all-optical subcarrier label-swapping system incorporating an integrated electro-absorption modulation laser (EML). The experiment results show error-free operation with negative penalty via optical regeneration to the payload.

articleTitle: Restorable mesh network design under demand uncertainty: toward "future proofed transport investments
abstract: We consider the span-restorable mesh capacity design problem where demand uncertainty is represented by a set of possible future scenarios. An integer program is formulated to study the tradeoff between initial network cost and robustness to uncertainty.

articleTitle: Hybrid WDM/TDM-PON for 128 subscribers using /spl lambda/-selection-free transmitters
abstract: A WDM/TDM-PON with /spl lambda/-selection-free transmitters is presented by cascading 1/spl times/16 AWGs and 1/spl times/8 splitters and employing ASE-injected FP-LDs. 1.25-Gb/s downstream and 622-Mb/s upstream transmissions over 60/spl deg/C temperature range are achieved in all 128 channels.

articleTitle: Beyond 80-Gbit/s-throughput monolithically integrated eight-channel WDM modulator module for multi-channel optical transmitter
abstract: A 10 Gbit/s /spl times/ 8 ch WDM modulator module with 50-GHz channel spacing is demonstrated. The module contains only one monolithically integrated WDM modulator chip that is only 15 mm /spl times/ 7 mm in size.

articleTitle: Maximizing resource sharing in WDM mesh networks with path-based protection and sparse OEO regeneration
abstract: We propose a resource-sharing scheme that supports three kinds of sharing scenarios in a WDM mesh network with path-based protection and sparse OEO regeneration. Several approaches are used to maximize the sharing of wavelength-links and OEO regenerators.

articleTitle: NTT's deployment of FTTH services
abstract: In Japan, high-speed Internet market has been growing rapidly. ADSL has been playing a leading role in delivering high-speed Internet access service, so far. A severe competition between new players other than telecommunication carriers brought a higher-speed service to be a central issue in the competition. As a result, higher-speed ADSL services have been widespread successively. At present, 24 Mbps service is a major service in ADSL. Higher-speed competition has also been leading FTTH market. Many players from various industries such as power suppliers and real estate companies have joined in the FTTH market. The number of FTTH users surpassed 688 thousands at the end of last September.

articleTitle: Ultra-high capacity WDM optical packet routing through an 8-node data vortex sub-network
abstract: We demonstrate routing of 8-WDM-channel 10 Gb/s optical packets through an 8-node sub-network of the data vortex, realizing virtual buffering within the switching fabric. Single pulse WDM encoding for the header simplifies packet control and reduces latency.

articleTitle: Bi-directional WDM passive optical network using spectrum-sliced light-emitting diodes
abstract: We demonstrate a WDM passive optical network using spectrum-sliced LED's. This network could accommodate more than 40 subscribers with 622-Mb/s downstream and 155-Mb/s upstream channels.

articleTitle: Optical networking research: a European perspective
abstract: This work presents a review of optical network research activities in Europe, based on projects funded by the EU and national governments. Research networks and new initiatives are discussed.

articleTitle: A simple dispersion measurement by using a self-seeding laser oscillation of Fabry-Perot laser diode
abstract: A simple dispersion measurement technique has been demonstrated by using a self-seeding laser oscillation of Fabry-Perot laser. Its performance was confirmed experimentally and shows to be comparable to commercial instruments employing expensive equipments and components.

articleTitle: Impact of stimulated Brillouin scattering of multimode pump light within co-pumped Raman amplifiers
abstract: We measure the signal power penalty after a co-pumped Raman amplifier from increased pump relative intensity noise due to stimulated Brillouin scattering, and propose an alternate pump reflection ratio to characterize this effect.

articleTitle: A novel passive optical network with dynamic wavelength allocation
abstract: A novel, high performance passive optical network employs dynamic wavelength allocation to provide bandwidth sharing across multiple physical passive optical networks. Tunable lasers and coarse/fine filtering combine to create a flexible new optical access solution.

articleTitle: All-optical wavelength conversion and regeneration
abstract: This paper reviews opportunities and challenges of all-optical devices for transparent networks. Trends and latest all-optical regeneration and wavelength conversion techniques are discussed with an emphasis on devices exploiting semiconductor optical amplifier nonlinearities.

articleTitle: 8 /spl times/ 10.709 Gb/s WDM transmission over 1050 km SMF using cascaded in-line semiconductor optical amplifier and DPSK modulation format
abstract: We have performed 8-channel WDM transmission over 1050 km SMF using cascaded in-line SOA and DPSK modulation format for the first time, more than 6 dB of power margin was achieved over FEC threshold.

articleTitle: A robust architecture for WDM radio-over-fiber access networks
abstract: A novel WDM radio-over-fiber network by dynamic wavelength allocation and upstream injection-locked Fabry-Perot laser scheme is proposed and experimentally verified. This architecture can provide the robust, flexible and cost-effective characteristics for large, radio terminals.

articleTitle: Optimized filtering for electronic equalizers in the presence of chromatic dispersion and PMD
abstract: For receivers using an adaptive threshold, a feed forward/decision feedback or a Viterbi equalizer with either single or polarization diversity inputs, optical and electrical filter bandwidths are investigated for chromatic dispersion and PMD.

articleTitle: In-service upgrade method for DWDM submarine cable system using ASE dummy lights
abstract: We propose the in-service upgrade method with ASE dummy lights. Two key technologies, appropriate arrangement of ASE dummy lights and overlap replacement of dummies, can minimize the performance fluctuation of the existing signals in upgrading.

articleTitle: Design fiber Bragg grating using iterative layer-peeling algorithm
abstract: We apply the fabrication constraint in the iterative layer-peeling algorithm, such that the new designed passband WDM grating is easier to fabricate and show better performance than that synthesized by conventional layer-peeling algorithm.

articleTitle: Q-factor fluctuations in long distance circulating loop transmission experiments
abstract: In this paper we discuss the merits of synchronous polarization control in circulating loop transmission experiments. We discuss the role of loop length, Q-factor fluctuations, and polarization evolution.

articleTitle: Multichannel single-shot transient signal measurements with a fiber delay line loop
abstract: A two-channel fiber-loop single-shot scope, which utilizes an optical fiber recirculating loop, has been developed for the measurement of electrical transient signals, with frequency responses above 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Stresses and strains frozen into optical fibers
abstract: In addition to residual elastic stresses and strains, viscoelasticity can also be frozen into optical fibers. Frozen-in viscoelasticity affects guiding properties of optical fibers and has been harnessed to produce all-fiber fundamental mode beam expanders.

articleTitle: Surface absorption in microstructured optical fibers
abstract: Spectroscopic detection of chemical species, SiOH and SiNH/sub 2/, located at the air/glass interface between the air holes and the silica core of a microstructured fiber is reported.

articleTitle: 8 /spl times/ 40 Gb/s RZ all-optical broadcasting utilizing an electroabsorption modulator
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate all-optical broadcasting through simultaneous 8 /spl times/ 40 Gb/s wavelength conversion in the RZ format based on cross absorption modulation in an electroabsorption modulator. The original intensity-modulated information is successfully duplicated onto eight wavelengths that comply with the ITU-T proposal. The advantages of the proposed wavelength conversion scheme are discussed.

articleTitle: Packaging of highly integrated PLC components
abstract: We discuss the progress of packaging techniques for highly integrated planar lightwave circuit (PLC) devices. Examples of thermal effects and the integration of power monitors demonstrate interactions between building blocks and the environment.

articleTitle: Very high order integrated optical filters
abstract: We synthesized very high order integrated optical filters up to the 11/sup th/ order by the means of coupled microring resonators. The fabricated devices exhibit low insertion loss, narrowband, flat-top and sharp roll-off.

articleTitle: High tolerance to coherent crosstalk of differential-phase-shift-keying
abstract: It is found experimentally that differential-phase-shift-keying with balanced detection offers /spl sim/6 dB higher tolerance to in-band coherent crosstalk than on-off-keying in optical signal-to-noise-ratio limited systems. An explanation of its high crosstalk tolerance is also provided.

articleTitle: 10 Gbit/s, 25 GHz spaced transmission over 800 km using dispersion compensation modules
abstract: We show error-free 10 Gbit/s, 25 GHz channel spaced transmission over 8/spl times/100 km SSMF without in-line dispersion compensation fiber. This is achieved using phase conjugation via cascaded sum and difference frequency generation in periodically poled lithium niobate waveguides.

articleTitle: Translucent photonic network dimensioning for equipment cost minimization
abstract: Network design method is proposed by combining advantages of link-based and path-based approaches. A trial design incorporating precise optical characteristics modeling showed 30% cost reduction while guaranteeing optical signal reachability for any possible traffic demands.

articleTitle: Characterization of polarization-dependent gain in Raman fiber amplifier
abstract: We present an analytic model to describe the polarization dependent gain (PDG) in fiber Raman amplifiers. We find simple analytical expressions that express the mean and the variance of PDG as a function of pump degree of polarization and polarization mode dispersion of the optical fiber for forward and backward pumping. Our results are in agreement with experiments previously reported.

articleTitle: Design procedures for slanted-angle SOI polarization rotators
abstract: We introduce general design rules for slanted-angle waveguides and novel single-mode SOI polarization rotators based on asymmetric waveguiding layer structures. Our SOI rotators offer significant advantages in loss, fabrication tolerance and size over III-V devices.

articleTitle: Optically clocked ultra long SOAs: a novel technique for high speed 3R signal regeneration
abstract: Ultra long SOAs are developed and applied for optical signal processing. An optically clocked UL-SOA is presented in a novel regeneration concept. Successful operation and regeneration is demonstrated by eye-analysis and BER-measurements at 40 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Direct measure of system margin enhancement by polarization scrambling
abstract: We have quantified the system margin afforded by polarization scrambling with a direct measurement of the errored events from a noise loaded FEC decoder. We have demonstrated a margin enhancement of 1.2 dB after 8,856 km transmission.

articleTitle: Passive optical NRZ-to-RZ converter
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple passive optical NRZ-to-RZ converter based on an optical filter. This filter could be made of a birefringent device and a polarizer. The measured results show that converted RZ signal is chirp-free and its duty ratio can be adjusted by varying the birefringence of optical filter.

articleTitle: Novel photocurrent-assisted wavelength (PAW) using a traveling-wave electroabsorption modulator with signal monitoring and regeneration capabilities
abstract: We report on a novel photocurrent-assisted wavelength converter using a traveling-wave electroabsorption modulator which also provides electrical monitoring and regeneration capabilities. The proposed concept is demonstrated with 2.5-Gb/s NRZ and 10-Gb/s RZ data formats.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion monitoring using the power ratio of two RF tones with a dispersion offset
abstract: We propose a dispersion monitoring technique using the power ratio of two RF tones with a dispersion offset, and demonstrate that this technique can monitor a wide range of accumulated dispersion with a good sensitivity.

articleTitle: RF measurement and theory of cross-polarization modulation
abstract: Using a high-speed polarimeter, we measure RF changes in the state-of-polarization induced by nonlinear and linear crosstalk in a lightwave communication system. Our experimental results show good agreement with a basic theoretical model.

articleTitle: Orthogonal optical labeling based on a 40 Gbit/s DPSK payload and a 2.5 Gbit/s IM label
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate label encoding/erasure and transmission for an orthogonally labeled signal using a 40 Gbit/s DPSK payload and an IM label. The influence of the modulation depth and the label erasure are discussed.

articleTitle: Flexible pulse waveform generation using a silica waveguide based spectrum synthesis circuit
abstract: We demonstrate pulse waveform shaping with a circuit employing an arrayed waveguide grating pair and amplitude-phase controllers. We flexibly synthesized the frequency components of a mode-locked laser to produce 40 GHz square pulses with various widths.

articleTitle: Polarization-mode dispersion measurement using a six-state RF phase-shift technique for high spectral efficiency
abstract: We demonstrate record spectral efficiency for RF phase-shift measurement of differential group delay and principal states of polarization. Unaveraged uncertainty is below 40 fs in 4.92 GHz bandwidth. Uncertainties and measurement procedures are detailed.

articleTitle: An optical/electrical two-step heterodyne for wideband 60 GHz radio-on-fiber access
abstract: We propose an optical/electrical two-step heterodyne technique for low cost Gbps-class 60 GHz radio-on-fiber (ROF) downlink access. Highly stable IF signal is achieved without expensive 60 GHz-oscillators in either base stations or wireless terminals.

articleTitle: Spectral anomalies due to coupling-induced frequency shifts in dielectric coupled-resonator filters
abstract: Coupling-induced frequency shift is identified as a source of spectral response degradation in higher-order coupled-resonator add/drop filters that must be compensated in design. The theoretical basis and experimental verification are presented, and generic solutions proposed.

articleTitle: Novel compact 40 GHz RZ-pulse-source based on self-pulsating phaseCOMB lasers
abstract: A novel compact 40 Gb/s RZ transmitter scheme based on a self-pulsating phaseCOMB laser is presented. Penalty free data transmission over 80 km SMF demonstrates the good system performance of the new transmitter device.

articleTitle: Successful demonstration of sub-harmonic injection locking for phase shifted self-pulsating DFB lasers at 168 GHz and beyond
abstract: We propose a new design of an ultra-high frequency pulsation laser, taking advantage of a phase shift effect. Injection locking function at 168 GHz and 210 GHz using sub-harmonic optical clock signals was experimentally verified for the first time.

articleTitle: Unstable Raman amplification due to Brillouin scattering and its suppression for 40Gb/s WDM transmission
abstract: The instability in Raman amplifiers due to Brillouin scattering is observed for the first time and successfully suppressed by phase modulation. A U-band 40 Gb/s WDM transmission experiment demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed suppression technique.

articleTitle: Economic benefits of all-optical cross connects and multi-haul DWDM systems for European national networks
abstract: A transparent multi-haul OXC architecture provides capex savings of up to 17% against an OADM architecture for a European network. The saving is more significant than in US networks due to shorter connection lengths.

articleTitle: Optical trellis-coded modulation (oTCM)
abstract: In a new transmission format the output of a 10 Gb/s convolutional FEC encoder is directly mapped on an optical 10 Gbaud DQPSK signal. Versus 10 Gb/s DPSK, 4.5 dB OSNR gain is predicted without any increase of bandwidth.

articleTitle: Reduction of self- and cross-phase modulation-induced impairments in long-haul WDM telecommunication systems via spectral inversion
abstract: We show by calculation that a spectral inverter placed within a long-haul WDM network can reduce impairments due to Kerr nonlinearities by 5 dB or more. The benefits are robust against non-idealities and asymmetry.

articleTitle: 1.3-/spl mu/m InGaAlAs directly modulated MQW RWG DFB lasers operating over 10 Gb/s and 100/spl deg/C
abstract: We briefly review 1.3-/spl mu/m InGaAlAs DFB RWG lasers that feature low-resistance notch-free gratings and are for greater than 10-Gb/s direct modulation at over 100/spl deg/C. The superior transmission properties and long-term reliability are also described.

articleTitle: A 10-/spl mu/s-tuning MEMS-actuated Gires-Tournois filter for use as a tunable wavelength demultiplexer and a tunable OCDMA encoder/decoder
abstract: We use a wavelength-tunable GTI mux/demux with 10 /spl mu/s switching time to demonstrate rapid wavelength switching of data streams in a WDM system as well as code hopping in a time-wavelength OCDMA system. We observe <0.5dB power-penalty.

articleTitle: Evaluation of tunable laser applications in metropolitan networks
abstract: We evaluate the system applications of tunable lasers. The automated provisioning value is limited by OEO pre-deployment cost in the multi-service metropolitan networks. Inventory savings typically justify small (< 20%) premium, and narrow-band tunability.

articleTitle: Wavelength-selective switching - architecture and technology overview
abstract: This work will provide an overview of node architectures and wavelength-switching technologies for the implementation of "all-optical" mesh networks.

articleTitle: Resource allocation method for optical VPN
abstract: We propose path computation algorithms for two resource allocation models for optical VPN, namely shared and dedicated. By simulation, we show that combined with proposed algorithm, dedicated model can achieve better resource usage efficiency.

articleTitle: Correlation and keying of Rayleigh scatter for loss and temperature sensing in parallel optical networks
abstract: We develop a method by which coherent optical frequency domain reflectometry (OFDR) can be used to "key" portions of optical fiber by measuring their complex Rayleigh backscatter signatures. We show that these complex keys can be used to locate specific fiber lengths embedded within a parallel optical network, and that they can further be used to interrogate any induced loss or temperature change in the identified portion of the network.
